**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

subject: Derek, I’m asking you to dig deep: We need to rally behind the DNC to ensure Democrats up and down the ballot have the support they need in the midterms in just 12 days.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Democratic National Committee, **[www
body:
We need to rally behind the DNC to ensure Democrats up and down the ballot have the support they need in the midterms in just 12 days. | |
---
I’ve been working to protect and expand our Democratic majorities for most of my career, and I can confidently tell you that next month’s midterm elections will be extremely consequential. Are you in our corner?

Peter, it's been a long, long, election cycle. Just to make it to this point, _11 days out from the election_ , has required huge amounts of time, energy, and resources. Our candidates have been forced to eat cheap jabs from the leftist media, battle through barrages of attack ads, and withstand falsified smear campaigns.

Unfortunately, these attacks have taken their toll. My team has identified 8 of our _top tier_ candidates now on **THIN ICE** , thanks to the Left's endless barrage of lies:
_**Jim Bognet (PA-08)
Barb Kirkmeyer (CO-08)
Tom Barrett (MI-7)
Marc Molinaro (NY-19)
Madison Gesiotto Gilbert (OH-13)
Tyler Kistner (MN-2)
Mark Robertson (NV-01)
Mike Lawler (NY-17)**_
The polls have been all over the place, but one thing is for certain: if these battleground races break in Democrats' favor - we're **DONE**.

subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losi
This sponsored message from American Defense News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zigtthk0ifn0gn1uee00sp3mk6ddgj4veptu168o_rp22sh2s8i66or3cjim8ob1c9h2bs) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. name: Ron Johnson
subject: a personal plea
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
|
---
| | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

$25 makes a difference. $25 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61748134:JyDOaNGNt:m:1:3364136623:FDDF2CA68413807BB883AFFD48193259:r "Johnson1")**_

Please, Peter, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: This is a long, but very personal message
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61747902:JbhQPNGNa:m:1:3359512271:BF5C88BC55F8C7978E27620317D2F916:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61747902:JbhQPNGNa:m:1:3359512271:BF5C88BC55F8C7978E27620317D2F916:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61747902:JbhQPNGNa:m:1:3359512271:BF5C88BC55F8C7978E27620317D2F916:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61747902:JbhQPNGNa:m:1:3359512271:BF5C88BC55F8C7978E27620317D2F916:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61747902:JbhQPNGNa:m:1:3359512271:BF5C88BC55F8C7978E27620317D2F916:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61747902:JbhQPNGNa:m:1:3359512271:BF5C88BC55F8C7978E27620317D2F916:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61747902:JbhQPNGNa:m:1:3359512271:BF5C88BC55F8C7978E27620317D2F916:r "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an
advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61747902:JbhQPNGNa:m:1:3359512271:BF5C88BC55F8C7978E27620317D2F916:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61747902:JbhQPNGNa:m:1:3359512271:BF5C88BC55F8C7978E27620317D2F916:r "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique
problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61747902:JbhQPNGNa:m:1:3359512271:BF5C88BC55F8C7978E27620317D2F916:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61747902:JbhQPNGNa:m:1:3359512271:BF5C88BC55F8C7978E27620317D2F916:r "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61747902:JbhQPNGNa:m:1:3359512271:BF5C88BC55F8C7978E27620317D2F916:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---

body:
I’ll take on the big fights and make sure Pennsylvanians don’t get screwed.

Derek, I’ve made it my mission to stop Pennsylvanians from getting screwed over — and hold those who take advantage of hardworking Pennsylvanians accountable for their actions. As Attorney General, I’ve returned millions of dollars in stolen wages to workers who earned them, canceled student debt from predatory lenders, made sure Pennsylvanians kept their health care, and helped survivors get justice from abuse by predator priests. Hi Peter,

My name is Gabby Giffords. I'm a former congresswoman, and 11 years ago, my life was changed forever when I survived a mass shooting at a constituent event in my hometown.

I decided to turn my pain into purpose by becoming a national gun safety advocate, and I've never looked back. But today, I'm not writing to talk about myself. I'm here to tell you about Seth Magaziner and his campaign to keep Rhode Island's 2nd District blue.

As Treasurer, Seth has stood up for working Rhode Islanders. He helped pass legislation to codify _Roe_ into Rhode Island law, worked to keep dangerous guns off our streets, and build a stronger and more equitable economy. Now, he's running for Rhode Island's open 2nd District seat to bring these fights to Congress and he's in for a tough race.

Seth is facing Trump-supporting Republican, Allan Fung, and election experts are calling this race a "toss-up." clean_body: I'm here to tell you about Seth Magaziner and his campaign to keep Rhode Island's 2nd District blue. Hi Peter, My name is Gabby Giffords. I'm a former congresswoman, and 11 years ago, my life was changed forever when I survived a mass shooting at a constituent event in my hometown. I decided to turn my pain into purpose by becoming a national gun safety advocate, and I've never looked back. But today, I'm not writing to talk about myself. I'm here to tell you about Seth Magaziner and his campaign to keep Rhode Island's 2nd District blue. As Treasurer, Seth has stood up for working Rhode Islanders. He helped pass legislation to codify Roe into Rhode Island law, worked to keep dangerous guns off our streets, and build a stronger and more equitable economy. Now, he's running for Rhode Island's open 2nd District seat to bring these fights to Congress and he's in for a tough race. Seth is facing Trump-supporting Republican, Allan Fung, and election experts are calling this race a "toss-up." With the latest polls showing this race is neck-and-neck, Seth needs our help to pull ahead in these final weeks.= If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = | = | = | = | = Republicans only need to flip five seats to retake the House majority, and they think they have one of their best chances in Rhode Island's 2nd District. That's why outside GOP groups are flooding the district with more than $2 million in attacks against Seth. With everything from gun safety to abortion access to health care on the ballot, we can't afford Allan Fung in Congress. body:
| | | Dear Peter, We have the key to stop our children from being corrupted by the radical Left in our schools -- and I need your immediate help to win... [**That 's why I'm asking you to make an emergency donation of $35 or more today.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61750024:JgnRMNGNJ:m:1:3366222934:7EDA3D0D2C4AAA97260A4EB2EB42137D:r) We recently filed suit against a school AND the activists pretending to be teachers to make them pay for what they're doing to our young and vulnerable children. Because the ONLY way we're going to stop them -- is to make these extremists pay for their crimes... And that's exactly what our landmark lawsuit does! Let me quickly give you the details in case you missed us while we were on **Laura Ingraham** 's great **Fox News **show talking about our case: Jessica Konen, the mother of an innocent 12-year-old girl, was called into her daughter's school and told that her daughter was now a "boy". She found out that her young daughter had been groomed into believing she was "transgender" and "bisexual"... Her impressionable daughter didn't even know these words until they were forced on her by these radicals. The school then pushed Jessica's innocent daughter to create a whole new identity -- complete with a new boy's name, new pronouns and had her use a different bathroom... They also created a "Gender Support Plan" and ordered the faculty to use her new name and pronouns -- all without her mother's knowledge! **And Jessica had no idea because her young daughter was told NOT to tell her mother since she couldn 't be "trusted"****.**
* These people are not real teachers.
* They're not concerned with teaching our children to read...
* They're not concerned with teaching our children math and arithmetic...
* They're not concerned with teaching history...

They want to indoctrinate an entire generation of children to reject their parent's values and embrace their radical Left-Wing propaganda -- and we have to stop them. [**That 's why I'm asking you to rush in your donation of $35 or more to help us stop these child groomers now. **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61750024:JgnRMNGNJ:m:1:3366222934:7EDA3D0D2C4AAA97260A4EB2EB42137D:r) After all this, Jessica did what any good mother would do and questioned the principal about what was happening to her young daughter at school... ... And what happened next? Child Protective Services was called to her house and "interviewed" her children! This grooming is happening behind closed doors in classrooms across the country... And it's happening in secret so parents, grandparents and the community don't know what's going on. Jessica's innocent daughter is just one of the countless victims -- and if we don't act, there will be more and more every day... Since we announced our lawsuit **The Ingraham Angle** , tons of concerned parents, grandparents and teachers have reached out to us. It's horrible and sickening that this is happening, but we have to stop it... And our lawsuit is the key. Political pressure and new laws will not work -- we must drag these radical activists and schools into court and make them pay. That's why our lawsuit names the individual "teachers" \-- we must hold **them** accountable... Only when these extremists are scared of being dragged into court and are forced to pay will they stop. Make no mistake -- if we win this landmark case every single one of these so-called teachers will take notice. They will think of the consequences before pushing their radical agenda on our vulnerable children... [**So please, join me today with a donation of $35 or more to fund our lawsuit to protect our kids from out of control leftist teachers.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61750024:JgnRMNGNJ:m:1:3366222934:7EDA3D0D2C4AAA97260A4EB2EB42137D:r) But to stop them, we need to win this case... And if you can give more today - $50, $100, $250 or more - I will use it to protect our children and our constitutional rights from these radical Left extremists. But, whatever amount you can send, I ask that you rush it in right away. And please know that here at the Center for American Liberty we don't just file lawsuits - we **WIN** them!! We recently won three major victories for religious liberty before the U.S. Supreme Court and we're fighting Big Tech and the politicians who are conspiring to silence and destroy conservatives... But this case to stop these extremists from corrupting and damaging our innocent children is too important to lose. And the only way to stop them is to make them know we're going to make them pay for their actions... [**So please, join the fight today****with your emergency tax-deductible donation of $20, $35, $50, $100 or more today.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61750024:JgnRMNGNJ:m:1:3366222934:7EDA3D0D2C4AAA97260A4EB2EB42137D:r) We're ready to go to the mat to win this case, but we can't do it without you. Thank you in advance for your support. Sincerely,

subject: I only have 2 words for you

body:
My opponent is trying to drown out my message before Election Day [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6289%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=3blbneOU0wq3rC04uCTpNw&sysid=1)
My opponent is trying to drown out my message before Election Day

| |
---
| | | I have two words for you, friend: _**THANK YOU!**_

I can’t even begin to express my gratitude for your support.

We’re just a few days away from the most important election of our lifetime, and I truly believe I wouldn’t be **closing in** on my opponent without the generous support you’ve shown me.

Thanks to your help, Team Smiley is finally _**making a change in Washington. **_

For too long, the American people have stood by and allowed the Democrats to destroy our country and communities.

Patty Murray and the Democrats have done nothing about it.

In my new television ad, former Patty Murray voters who are tired of watching Washington be decimated by the destructive and reckless agenda the Democrats are enacting.

They share their stories and explain why I'm the right candidate to get Washington back on track.

Unfortunately, my opponent is trying to drown out my message before Election Day because she doesn’t want voters to see the truth.

_**[I’m humbly asking if you can chip in to help keep my ad on the air!](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c89288%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=9XSN2Xkfi0ilG1KMyYfhEQ&sysid=1 "I’m humbly asking if you can chip in to help
keep my ad on the air!")**_

I hate to ask again because you’ve already shown me so much support, but I’d appreciate anything you can give today!

---
| | [HELP SPREAD MY MESSAGE](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c89289%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Cch8Lr3ZRayFF5PZcti2tQ&sysid=1 "HELP SPREAD MY MESSAGE")
---

For the first time in decades, we have a _**real shot**_ at changing the Pacific Northwest. Let’s finish strong!

Humbly,

Tiffany Smiley

---

---

---

Tiffany Smiley is _**CLOSING IN**_ on her Democrat opponent Patty Murray for the race for Senate in Washington!
---
| | | [HELP TIFFANY TAKE THE LEAD](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c89281%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=6ZxcMVJEEIg3kPhjToyexQ&sysid=1 "HELP TIFFANY TAKE THE LEAD")
---

The entire nation is watching and waiting to see if Tiffany can take down a 30-year career politician to bring real change to the Pacific Northwest.

With the polls nearly _neck and neck,_ there’s no time left to waste. We need grassroots supporters from every corner of the country to help boost Tiffany’s momentum heading into November.

The time is NOW to change the trajectory of our country. Supporting Tiffany is supporting the future of our nation.
_**[Be a part of history by chipping in to support Tiffany today!](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c89282%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xyoXfA%2fHRHzdOjJqanHHnQ&sysid=1 "Be a part of history by chipping in to
support Tiffany today! ")**_

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c89283%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KFCOV3YcOsdWgNKEr8noqg&sysid=1 "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c89284%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Jjg0Xx%2bM7g5%2bQt%2fB26oMQQ&sysid=1 "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help
in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c89295%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=w7o56TDpZiAEQj4CntkHog&sysid=1 "Step up now!")**_

I've spent a lot of time away from my family and friends, spending long hours traveling across Washington State talking to voters about their needs.

It's all been worth it to see the grassroots movement we've started in Washington, but it isn't always easy.

| Peter,
Today, we celebrate the day our great state was first admitted to the Union...
158 years ago, Nevada was Battle Born!
I want to wish all who live here, work here, and make this great state special a happy Nevada Day today. Home means Nevada, and in a little over ONE WEEK, we are taking this great state back!
---
| [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001rQ7MoPxh3V07pBfh_mOkSSTv35RtC93Az-NjYdOO3Qm38yiJjl7Lr7-0xehLfxP3r8ewFBLR3nnpbjuMwUsu04ebWDb2xNJKhbZjsxBBlmacYT1vhCuah_6lLlAhcRMruMVEBDp7vZjch_CrudDeKcrslP6CUzjt&c=_ABHAJw59chXLe1fScVGE9k4nTlYvtdHFfwS_T8x5a_JFOoGz2cepg==&ch=UYZ-jc2hXrPWLHcnXS9D1YrpQ6IAy-XBx7aR9q7ku9O2OGv9eSUcZw==)
---
| Whether you find yourself at a parade, at one of our many wonderful festivals, or at home with friends and family, I hope we all can take the time to celebrate Nevada today.
The Silver State may be suffering from poor leadership right now... But come November 8, we are changing that and Keeping Nevada Safe for years to come.
Happy Nevada Day, Sheriff Joe Lombardo
P.S. - Critical votes that will affect Nevada's future are being cast RIGHT NOW. Friends, For years, we have talked about Stacey Abrams' shady network of political organizations - and cronies - who work in concert to champion their fearless leader and advance her radical agenda. We've also mentioned that all of the above (including Abrams) are making big money along the way. Recently, we were reminded how much money you can make by being a loyal foot solider for a failed gubernatorial candidate. There's no doubt that the grift is real! **Fox News: Stacey Abrams' group funnels thousands to director's family and friends with no political experience** [According to a Fox News investigation, "The Abrams-founded Fair Fight PAC is funneling the cash to individuals close to her longtime aide Andre Fields, who acts as the PAC's political director...Fields' sister, Darius Faulk, is one of the cash recipients. The Fair Fight PAC has disbursed more than $120,000 to her for training consultant services since August 2021."](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/434664?id=3492662.622.1.685858ffec6ea67a9d9f8c3fc526e2a2) **Politico: Abrams’ campaign chair collected millions in legal fees from voting rights organization** And this week, numerous media outlets reported that ["Fair Fight Action, the nonprofit founded by Abrams, paid her close friend and ally’s law firm $9.4 million in 2019 and 2020, with two more years of billing yet to be disclosed."](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/434664?id=3492662.623.1.d4f846ff4258eea7869015766d3f089c) This type of behavior is commonplace for Team Abrams and it has created distrust - even amongst Georgia Democrats - for years. Back in 2015, Abrams and her voter registration group, New Georgia Project, were under [intense scrutiny](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/434664?id=3492662.624.1.9dee4007efa0a37c982acbf841c966e1) after failing to register a consequential number of voters - despite raising $4 million. **"Democratic donors and strategists gathered at a Midtown Atlanta law firm to discuss what went wrong. When the New Georgia Project’s work came under question, several who attended the meeting described a sharp inquiry that mirrored questions resonating in political circles: Where did the money go?"** When you peel back the onion, you find that another organization in Abrams' network, Third Sector Development, plays a huge role in this scheme. Founded in 1998, Third Sector Development is the group Stacey Abrams used as a clearinghouse for the 2014 voter registration drive. Upon review of tax returns and public filings, the organization paid Abrams $177,500 in 2014 and nearly $400,000 on a handful of key staffers and consultants. And as they say...the rest is history. Abrams leveraged that network for political and personal gain. Once indebted to the IRS, Abrams is now a multi-millionaire - and celebrity - who lives a lavish lifestyle while claiming to be fighting for the people. This November, we have an opportunity to derail the Stacey Abrams' gravy train once and for all. [Chip in $100 right now](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/434664?id=3492662.625.1.4f5869ece8d5aa3378db81e6b46b90d6) and help us expose her network for what it really is: a scam! subject: Have you seen what they're doing to our kids?
body:
| | | Dear Peter, We have the key to stop our children from being corrupted by the radical Left in our schools -- and I need your immediate help to win... [**That 's why I'm asking you to make an emergency donation of $35 or more today.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61750920:6lUrZNGgN:m:1:3345639852:5B9BB5FF898BBBC36FF1B43AA1AF29E3:r) We recently filed suit against a school AND the activists pretending to be teachers to make them pay for what they're doing to our young and vulnerable children. Because the ONLY way we're going to stop them -- is to make these extremists pay for their crimes... And that's exactly what our landmark lawsuit does! Let me quickly give you the details in case you missed us while we were on **Laura Ingraham** 's great **Fox News **show talking about our case: Jessica Konen, the mother of an innocent 12-year-old girl, was called into her daughter's school and told that her daughter was now a "boy". She found out that her young daughter had been groomed into believing she was "transgender" and "bisexual"... Her impressionable daughter didn't even know these words until they were forced on her by these radicals. The school then pushed Jessica's innocent daughter to create a whole new identity -- complete with a new boy's name, new pronouns and had her use a different bathroom... They also created a "Gender Support Plan" and ordered the faculty to use her new name and pronouns -- all without her mother's knowledge! **And Jessica had no idea because her young daughter was told NOT to tell her mother since she couldn 't be "trusted"****.**
* These people are not real teachers.
* They're not concerned with teaching our children to read...
* They're not concerned with teaching our children math and arithmetic...
* They're not concerned with teaching history...

They want to indoctrinate an entire generation of children to reject their parent's values and embrace their radical Left-Wing propaganda -- and we have to stop them. [**That 's why I'm asking you to rush in your donation of $35 or more to help us stop these child groomers now. **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61750920:6lUrZNGgN:m:1:3345639852:5B9BB5FF898BBBC36FF1B43AA1AF29E3:r) After all this, Jessica did what any good mother would do and questioned the principal about what was happening to her young daughter at school... ... And what happened next? Child Protective Services was called to her house and "interviewed" her children! This grooming is happening behind closed doors in classrooms across the country... And it's happening in secret so parents, grandparents and the community don't know what's going on. Jessica's innocent daughter is just one of the countless victims -- and if we don't act, there will be more and more every day... Since we announced our lawsuit **The Ingraham Angle** , tons of concerned parents, grandparents and teachers have reached out to us. It's horrible and sickening that this is happening, but we have to stop it... And our lawsuit is the key. Political pressure and new laws will not work -- we must drag these radical activists and schools into court and make them pay. That's why our lawsuit names the individual "teachers" \-- we must hold **them** accountable... Only when these extremists are scared of being dragged into court and are forced to pay will they stop. Make no mistake -- if we win this landmark case every single one of these so-called teachers will take notice. They will think of the consequences before pushing their radical agenda on our vulnerable children... [**So please, join me today with a donation of $35 or more to fund our lawsuit to protect our kids from out of control leftist teachers.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61750920:6lUrZNGgN:m:1:3345639852:5B9BB5FF898BBBC36FF1B43AA1AF29E3:r) But to stop them, we need to win this case... And if you can give more today - $50, $100, $250 or more - I will use it to protect our children and our constitutional rights from these radical Left extremists. But, whatever amount you can send, I ask that you rush it in right away. And please know that here at the Center for American Liberty we don't just file lawsuits - we **WIN** them!! We recently won three major victories for religious liberty before the U.S. Supreme Court and we're fighting Big Tech and the politicians who are conspiring to silence and destroy conservatives... But this case to stop these extremists from corrupting and damaging our innocent children is too important to lose. And the only way to stop them is to make them know we're going to make them pay for their actions... [**So please, join the fight today****with your emergency tax-deductible donation of $20, $35, $50, $100 or more today.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61750920:6lUrZNGgN:m:1:3345639852:5B9BB5FF898BBBC36FF1B43AA1AF29E3:r) We're ready to go to the mat to win this case, but we can't do it without you. Thank you in advance for your support. Sincerely,

Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

name: Blake Masters
subject: I want you to know why I’m running to take back Arizona
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blake Masters for Senate**
body:
I wanted to reach out personally | I know you've heard a lot from my campaign lately, but with only a few weeks left until the Election...

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61750944:6e8hZNGNf:m:1:3367311000:BA813AFDAD1A3BE3A440E0C7F837E120:r)

Peter,

Do you have a minute?

I know you've heard a lot from my campaign lately, but with only a few weeks left until the Election, I wanted to take the time to reach out personally.

Let me start by telling you about myself and why I felt compelled to run for Senate: Arizona has helped shape my life for the better \- and I owe this state so much. I grew up here and am proud to still call Arizona home, along with my incredible wife Catherine and our three boys.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61750944:6e8hZNGNf:m:1:3367311000:BA813AFDAD1A3BE3A440E0C7F837E120:r)

That's why it's so deeply troubling to see what the failed leadership of the Biden administration and my opponent, Mark Kelly, have done to our nation.

Whether it is _**dangerous criminals**_ pouring across our unsecured border, _**crushing inflation**_ that is killing family-owned businesses, or _**teaching toxic ideologies**_ to our children, Democrats are destroying the America we know and love.

This country deserves so much better, **and I 'm running to create a more prosperous future for ALL Americans.**

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61750944:6e8hZNGNf:m:1:3367311000:BA813AFDAD1A3BE3A440E0C7F837E120:r)

**[HELP DELIVER A BETTER FUTURE FOR ARIZONA AND AMERICA.>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61750944:6e8hZNGNf:m:1:3367311000:BA813AFDAD1A3BE3A440E0C7F837E120:r)**

I know what it takes to tackle difficult problems and build success from scratch. I'm an America First outsider who has spent my career in the private sector creating jobs and investing in our youth. I'm committed to bringing YOUR voice to Washington _**and won 't EVER back down from fighting to put America First.**_

Let me be absolutely clear - _I 'm not interested in the political games of Washington._ I'm running for Senate because decent, hard-working people like **YOU** deserve solutions to the problems you face on a daily basis.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61750944:6e8hZNGNf:m:1:3367311000:BA813AFDAD1A3BE3A440E0C7F837E120:r)

We all know what is at stake on November 8th: The future of our state, our country, and control of the Senate. It is beyond critical that we restore **competent, conservative leadership** in Washington.

My race is extremely close and will be decided in this campaign's final days and weeks. I'm confident that united, we WILL win this election for the America First movement and begin building a better future for our nation. I'd be honored to have your support in this critical fight.

**[PLEASE CHIP IN ANY AMOUNT YOU CAN TO HELP US WIN THIS ELECTION FOR THE AMERICA FIRST MOVEMENT.>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61750944:6e8hZNGNf:m:1:3367311000:BA813AFDAD1A3BE3A440E0C7F837E120:r)**

Thank you,

Blake Masters
U.S. Senate Candidate from Arizona

**[CONTRIBUTE NOW>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61750944:6e8hZNGNf:m:1:3367311000:BA813AFDAD1A3BE3A440E0C7F837E120:r)**

| **Paid for by Blake Masters for Senate**

I don't want to sound like an alarmist, but yesterday's fundraising totals shocked me to the core. ---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751167:JtAttNGN2:m:1:3331421248:195F5E904BFFC3081B3DEBB9C412764A:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of
hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751167:JtAttNGN2:m:1:3331421248:195F5E904BFFC3081B3DEBB9C412764A:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751167:JtAttNGN2:m:1:3331421248:195F5E904BFFC3081B3DEBB9C412764A:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751167:JtAttNGN2:m:1:3331421248:195F5E904BFFC3081B3DEBB9C412764A:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751167:JtAttNGN2:m:1:3331421248:195F5E904BFFC3081B3DEBB9C412764A:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751167:JtAttNGN2:m:1:3331421248:195F5E904BFFC3081B3DEBB9C412764A:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751167:JtAttNGN2:m:1:3331421248:195F5E904BFFC3081B3DEBB9C412764A:r "I will always stand up for our heroes
and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751167:JtAttNGN2:m:1:3331421248:195F5E904BFFC3081B3DEBB9C412764A:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751167:JtAttNGN2:m:1:3331421248:195F5E904BFFC3081B3DEBB9C412764A:r "Washingtonians need a voice to find
solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751167:JtAttNGN2:m:1:3331421248:195F5E904BFFC3081B3DEBB9C412764A:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751167:JtAttNGN2:m:1:3331421248:195F5E904BFFC3081B3DEBB9C412764A:r "KEEP
TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751167:JtAttNGN2:m:1:3331421248:195F5E904BFFC3081B3DEBB9C412764A:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751168:JtAttNGN2:m:1:3331421248:195F5E904BFFC3081B3DEBB9C412764A:r "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751168:JtAttNGN2:m:1:3331421248:195F5E904BFFC3081B3DEBB9C412764A:r "Rush support now to be a part of history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751168:JtAttNGN2:m:1:3331421248:195F5E904BFFC3081B3DEBB9C412764A:r "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")
---

---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751170:JtAttNGN2:m:1:3331421248:195F5E904BFFC3081B3DEBB9C412764A:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751170:JtAttNGN2:m:1:3331421248:195F5E904BFFC3081B3DEBB9C412764A:r "Step up now!")**_

body:
Peter, Cory Booker is right. We are running out of time to reach the voters we need to win this toss-up election.
Peter, Cory Booker is right. We _are_ running out of time to reach the voters we need to win this toss-up election.

Peter,

Yesterday was not a good fundraising day, and that is putting it lightly. **If I'm being totally honest, it was the worst day of the month so far.**

**Just 22 people donated to the email that I sent out yesterday for a total of $370.** If you read the note yesterday morning, then you may recall that needed that email to raise $10,038, more than**_27 times what we wound up raising by the day's end._**

Help us compete with Caruso's outrageous spending

Team — Here’s the deal:

the next 11 days:
#
Peter,
This race is getting closer. Washington is not a safe blue state. We will need to fight with everything we’ve got for the next 11 days to stop Tiffany Smiley and Mitch McConnell from taking back control of the Senate.
Every day, I am fighting for what’s best for families and working people across the state. Recent legislation Democrats passed will create new jobs, lower prescription drug prices, and put money back into your pockets. Cicely Davis

subject: Have you seen what they're doing to our kids?
body:
| | | Dear Peter, We have the key to stop our children from being corrupted by the radical Left in our schools -- and I need your immediate help to win... [**That 's why I'm asking you to make an emergency donation of $35 or more today.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61750918:6-1nXNGND:m:1:3317145305:206020383F35490A989B93131AB77468:r) We recently filed suit against a school AND the activists pretending to be teachers to make them pay for what they're doing to our young and vulnerable children. Because the ONLY way we're going to stop them -- is to make these extremists pay for their crimes... And that's exactly what our landmark lawsuit does! Let me quickly give you the details in case you missed us while we were on **Laura Ingraham** 's great **Fox News **show talking about our case: Jessica Konen, the mother of an innocent 12-year-old girl, was called into her daughter's school and told that her daughter was now a "boy". She found out that her young daughter had been groomed into believing she was "transgender" and "bisexual"... Her impressionable daughter didn't even know these words until they were forced on her by these radicals. The school then pushed Jessica's innocent daughter to create a whole new identity -- complete with a new boy's name, new pronouns and had her use a different bathroom... They also created a "Gender Support Plan" and ordered the faculty to use her new name and pronouns -- all without her mother's knowledge! **And Jessica had no idea because her young daughter was told NOT to tell her mother since she couldn 't be "trusted"****.**
* These people are not real teachers.
* They're not concerned with teaching our children to read...
* They're not concerned with teaching our children math and arithmetic...
* They're not concerned with teaching history...

They want to indoctrinate an entire generation of children to reject their parent's values and embrace their radical Left-Wing propaganda -- and we have to stop them. [**That 's why I'm asking you to rush in your donation of $35 or more to help us stop these child groomers now. **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61750918:6-1nXNGND:m:1:3317145305:206020383F35490A989B93131AB77468:r) After all this, Jessica did what any good mother would do and questioned the principal about what was happening to her young daughter at school... ... And what happened next? Child Protective Services was called to her house and "interviewed" her children! This grooming is happening behind closed doors in classrooms across the country... And it's happening in secret so parents, grandparents and the community don't know what's going on. Jessica's innocent daughter is just one of the countless victims -- and if we don't act, there will be more and more every day... Since we announced our lawsuit **The Ingraham Angle** , tons of concerned parents, grandparents and teachers have reached out to us. It's horrible and sickening that this is happening, but we have to stop it... And our lawsuit is the key. Political pressure and new laws will not work -- we must drag these radical activists and schools into court and make them pay. That's why our lawsuit names the individual "teachers" \-- we must hold **them** accountable... Only when these extremists are scared of being dragged into court and are forced to pay will they stop. Make no mistake -- if we win this landmark case every single one of these so-called teachers will take notice. They will think of the consequences before pushing their radical agenda on our vulnerable children... [**So please, join me today with a donation of $35 or more to fund our lawsuit to protect our kids from out of control leftist teachers.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61750918:6-1nXNGND:m:1:3317145305:206020383F35490A989B93131AB77468:r) But to stop them, we need to win this case... And if you can give more today - $50, $100, $250 or more - I will use it to protect our children and our constitutional rights from these radical Left extremists. But, whatever amount you can send, I ask that you rush it in right away. And please know that here at the Center for American Liberty we don't just file lawsuits - we **WIN** them!! We recently won three major victories for religious liberty before the U.S. Supreme Court and we're fighting Big Tech and the politicians who are conspiring to silence and destroy conservatives... But this case to stop these extremists from corrupting and damaging our innocent children is too important to lose. And the only way to stop them is to make them know we're going to make them pay for their actions... [**So please, join the fight today****with your emergency tax-deductible donation of $20, $35, $50, $100 or more today.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61750918:6-1nXNGND:m:1:3317145305:206020383F35490A989B93131AB77468:r) We're ready to go to the mat to win this case, but we can't do it without you. Thank you in advance for your support. Sincerely,

body:
We need to pick up the pace ASAP or this race could be over...
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zddjbulqrm3ibddjb142mp2sf4r4dd4c2259g85o_rp22sh2s8i66or3cjjmeo34sdh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jm8p79d9j6iprect66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2uipm3dj56eob8sjje5h79p3gstjb5dr1eppm2tdmm6q72tb661jb2dtlehojappnq9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphh62qr9o3ietj38p5l6djr1db5e8iv0)

|
Fellow American,

I wouldn’t be reaching out to you so **frantically** _if this wasn’t a dire situation ..._ but my Democrat-endorsed opponent is **outraising my campaign** and we’re less than two weeks away from Election Day.

[**This critical Senate race could be over unless I hear from you and 15 more conservatives from your area in the next 15 minutes.**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zp1tbgrkv6ie4kkhing8l8qrt4f59d357dd342g0_rp22sh2s8i66or3cjjmeo34sdh2bs)

Now is not the time to fall behind - **too much is at stake in this election for us to lose.** I called my team and asked them what I can do to pick up the pace. Their response? **REACH OUT TO YOU, Fellow American.**

[**Please, answer my call today and rush in your support.**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z0tfi9atmdn5ua16h0itot1ne9lp040fcs6soh10_rp22sh2s8i66or3cjjmeo34sdh2bs) If I win – Republicans will win back the Senate majority. **If I lose** - well, you know. We can’t let that happen.

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zsrqd0bnd26g2cill34d476lbts5tecckjgrtsog_rp22sh2s8i66or3cjjmeo34sdh2bs)
[** TAKE ACTION ➞ **](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zqg6jdmnhebllha1m6e1g0qh6bagtibehiafd43o_rp22sh2s8i66or3cjjmeo34sdh2bs)

The Democrats are determined to win in Utah. Chuck Schumer knows a WIN here is the ONLY WAY the left can hold their majority.

**My campaign is being outraised** and time is running out before Election Day. This is the time when critical ad placements are made and without money in the bank - my opponent will be able to reach more voters at a crucial stage in this race.

[**Please, Fellow American, I need to hear from you and 15 other conservatives from your area in the next 15 minutes or this race could be over.**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z2sqmf41qkj8o0hsapnigou9mrusrepqsu8t8p48_rp22sh2s8i66or3cjjmeo34sdh2bs)

Help me win and help Republicans take back the Senate majority. **I’m counting on hearing from you.**

For America,
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zmoh0nc30rmj15rvh3jornmntbh7plsf9gs7adjo_)
Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

[** JOIN TEAM MIKE ➞ **](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z8lijmc1afj8sn621ton8rhojn3dhq2lfm702148_rp22sh2s8i66or3cjjmeo34sdh2bs)

body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221028&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221028&amount=28]
Team,
We’ve known all year that I’m running in one of the country’s most competitive House races — it’s a new district, filled with tens of thousands of new voters to meet, and only voted for President Biden by less than a percentage point. To that end, we knew we’d have to communicate early: my first TV ad aired on July 5, the earliest I’ve ever gone up on TV. We’ve released 9 ads since across our three media markets, Detroit, Lansing, and Flint, which you can watch here [https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCpZaVXq7xHeiFQTPBqFC4gQ] .
But in the last few weeks, these critical TV ads have gotten more expensive than we ever could have fathomed, even in a race this competitive.
The reach of a TV ad is measured in gross ratings points: ads need to reach about 1200-1500 points to really make a mark. And when we wrote our initial television budget, we knew based on 2018 and 2020’s races that the cost per point in our markets would go up exponentially — we figured, based on past races, that Detroit could get as high as $440 per point, and Lansing could go up to $150 per point.
2022 has been an election year like any other. Not only do we have competitive statewide and Congressional races, but *three* ballot initiatives fighting for time on the airwaves. Ad pricing is all supply and demand. The more demand there is for air time, the more ads cost.
So in Lansing? Our budget has nearly doubled — in the final week, it’s looking like we could pay nearly $300 per point. And in Detroit, which covers some of the most critical independent voters in our district? We’re being charged closer to $660 per point.
This is the most competitive House race in Michigan and one of the most competitive House races in the country — and the results are going to be close. Our path to victory requires staying on TV in the same rate we have been.
I’m asking if you’ll chip in today to help us maintain our television spending in our district: it’s expensive, but if we can stay on TV, we’ve got a shot to win. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221028&amount=28]

Many of the candidates that we are supporting are competing against Republican campaigns with full coffers. Peter, we don't have to tell you how important this election is. Dear , Did you know that in Connecticut, nearly 40 percent of ballots that soldiers said they submitted never arrived?(CT Post, April 13, 2013).Connecticut has over 4,200 active-duty military personnel serving in the armed forces. Our service men and women vote absentee from all over the world using a universal OCOVO application for absentee ballots or by downloading a PDF from the Secretary of the State website. It is estimated that an overseas military voter and eligible dependent need 45 days to cast their vote in time for an election.In 2020 an estimated 42% voted in the Connecticut presidential election which is below the average of 47% of the military voting in 2020. Over 54% of all military voters report difficulties voting because of the lengthy mail times or because of difficulty accessing their state’s websites. In all, 88% have access to the internet, and only 70% have access to a printer. My vision is a multipart program to reduce mail/transit time and eventually eliminate all mail with a fully secure digital program for voting whereby military voting timelines are measured in days and not weeks.To read my full plan, [click here](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=2ab022cfc4&e=8763c56857). Thank you and Godspeed,
Dominic RapiniRepublican Candidate for Secretary of the State

| | | | | _Peter,_ I’m Paul Begala. I’m a Democratic campaign strategist, former counselor to President Bill Clinton, and I’ve dedicated my career to electing Democrats up and down the ballot.

So today, I’m reaching out about one of the most important races this cycle: **We have the incredible opportunity to unseat one of the worst Republicans in the US House, Rep. Chabot, and replace him with a champion for families.**

Our slim House majority is on the line in less than two weeks, and I know Greg Landsman is the leader we need to retire Chabot and protect our democracy, fundamental rights, and so much more.

**[Will you join me in supporting Greg Landsman’s people-powered campaign for this Ohio toss-up seat by chipping in $3 today? We need all hands on deck to get this done »](https://default.salsalabs.org/T437382dd-390d-4e70-953b-1f1826722a30/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

It’s imperative that we elect strong Democrats like Greg Landsman this year.

_They’ve made it clear:_ They want a national ban on abortion. They want to stack the Supreme Court with even more extremists. And they want to tear down the fundamental core of our democracy.

We can’t get complacent, Peter. We’ve fought for too hard and for too long to let that happen.

name: Aadland For Congress
subject: Erik's Latest Endorser
body:
| | | |
---
---
|
# Secretary Mike Pompeo Endorsement
---
|
---
| | |
---|---
|
Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, announces a formal endorsement from 70th Secretary of State Mike Pompeo.

Michael Pompeo was sworn in as the 70th Secretary of State on April 26, 2018. He previously served as Director of the Central Intelligence Agency from January 2017 to April 2018.

Prior to joining the Trump Administration, Secretary Pompeo was serving in his fourth term as congressman from Kansas' 4th District. He served on the House Intelligence Committee, as well as the Energy and Commerce Committee and House Select Benghazi Committee.

Prior to his service in Congress, Secretary Pompeo founded Thayer Aerospace, where he served as CEO for more than a decade. He later became President of Sentry International, an oilfield equipment manufacturing, distribution, and service company.

Secretary Pompeo graduated first in his class at the United States Military Academy at West Point in 1986 and served as a cavalry officer patrolling the Iron Curtain before the fall of the Berlin Wall. He also served with the 2nd Squadron, 7th Cavalry in the US Army's Fourth Infantry Division.

After leaving active duty, Secretary Pompeo graduated from Harvard Law School, having been an editor of the Harvard Law Review.
---
| In a statement sent to Erik Aadland's campaign, Secretary Pompeo said:
"Whereas the current administration has failed to uphold our values both domestically and abroad, Erik Aadland will fight for policies that restore economic equilibrium, safe communities, and credible leadership on the world stage. Erik's whole career, from the military to the private sector, has been in service to building a strong America. We need elected leadership that understands America's role in championing the cause of freedom. Erik Aadland is one such leader, and I am excited to endorse him for Congress."
---
| |
---
---
|
# Erik's Remarks
---
| |
---
|
---
| "As a fellow member of West Point's Long Gray Line and the Army Armor Officer Corps, it is a distinct honor to receive Secretary Pompeo's endorsement. Secretary Pompeo has dedicated his life to serving this great nation and defending our freedom. He has never wavered from his oath to protect the United States Constitution against enemies foreign and domestic. Having taken that same oath and having dedicated myself to the same cause of freedom, I will continue to live the words of our shared alma mater: "Duty, Honor, Country." It is the greatest privilege to serve our country alongside Secretary Pompeo."

name: Bernie Sanders
subject: We need my friend Peter Welch in the Senate
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT
body:
With a 50-50 Senate, we have to win every seat this November to keep the majority.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=1134%2E61531%2EVf-k5Z)
Friends,
In just a moment, I’m going to ask you to make a contribution to support my friend Peter Welch’s campaign to join me as Vermont’s other U.S. Senator. But first, let me tell you why he’s a progressive champion worth supporting.
Peter left college to organize against racist housing discrimination in Chicago, which set him on the path to a lifetime of political activism. When he graduated from law school, many of his classmates went to Wall Street or K Street. Instead, he moved to Bridge Street in rural Vermont and became one of the county’s first public defenders.
He served in the statehouse for over a decade and has been serving in Congress alongside me since 2006. In the House, he’s been fighting for a Green New Deal, Medicare for All and lower prescription drug costs.
Peter is exactly the kind of progressive champion we need in the Senate. So I am asking:
[**Will you pitch in a small donation today to support Peter Welch's campaign for Senate? We need a champion like him to fight for progressive change.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4747?t=3&akid=1134%2E61531%2EVf-k5Z)
[DONATE ](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4747?t=9&t=10&akid=1134%2E61531%2EVf-k5Z)
---
When I was elected Senator, Peter won the House seat that I had vacated. Working alongside Peter as part of Vermont’s congressional delegation in the years since, I’ve seen up close his dedication to the people of Vermont and progressive causes around the country.
With a 50-50 Senate, we have to win every seat this November to keep the majority. And we all know how much is at stake: reproductive freedom, Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, and more.
That’s why I’m asking:
[**Will you please make a small contribution to Peter Welch’s campaign for Senate? We’re just 11 days away from the election, and we have to hold this seat to keep the Senate blue.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4747?t=4&akid=1134%2E61531%2EVf-k5Z)
[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4747?t=6&akid=1134%2E61531%2EVf-k5Z)
---
In solidarity,
Bernie Sanders

Patriot Zach Rehl received an honorable discharge from the United States Marine Corps...and received a 100% disability rating from the Department of Veterans Affairs.

Zach has been held without bail this entire time.

**
As you can imagine, all of this has been brutally hard on Zach, his wife, and two daughters. No freedom...no rights...no due process...IN AMERICA!

**Patriot, that’s why I’ve filed two critically important class action lawsuits on behalf of each and every January 6 Peaceful Protester who are getting brutally abused by the justice system as I write you this urgent email.

You and I, and the people we love in are in grave danger.

**
That’s why I ask to stand with me at this crucial time.

**I’m Larry Klayman, the founder of Judicial Watch and founder and General Counsel of Freedom Watch.
**
I’m a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who’s fought for the American people for 45 years.

You’ve seen me on cable news outlets and heard me on radio talk shows.

**I’m proud to say I am the first lawyer to EVER obtain a court ruling that an American president committed a crime when I won my case against Bill Clinton.
**
I worked closely with Congressman Bob Barr and other impeachment managers to IMPEACH criminal Bill Clinton.

And I SUCCESSFULLY represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

Not to mention that I also enjoined Obama’s corrupt NSA from mass surveillance on hundreds of millions of Americans and killed Obama’s illegal amnesty for over 5 million illegal aliens, a case that went all the way to the Supreme Court!

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents – AND WIN!
**
And now I’m pursuing two class action lawsuits and other important legal actions to get justice for the January 6 Protesters and take on Joe Biden’s rotten regime in court.

**Nobody else is doing what I’m doing in court to get justice for these poor people.
**
[Patriot, PLEASE help me double down in my fight to GET JUSTICE FOR ALL JANUARY 6 PROTESTERS AND SET THEM FREE with your absolutely vital gift of $25, $50, $100 or even more RIGHT NOW.

I’m using two powerful lawsuits and other hard-hitting legal actions to do this.

You and I can save our country if we act peacefully and legally NOW.

Sincerely,

Larry Klayman
Founder of both Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch
Current Chairman and General Counsel of Freedom Watch, Inc.

body:

Peter,

My husband has always been a fearless fighter and a true servant leader.

He fought for our country, fought for child victims of heinous crimes as a federal prosecutor, and now fights for Floridians as the leader of this great state.

Now, he is up for re-election in the most consequential race in Florida’s history.

I cannot express how important it is that we re-elect Governor DeSantis to continue serving as our Governor and continue fighting to keep Florida Free.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=80d5c931095fbfb01bf9f2c02a2c28cdae443bf60093b89611ced6538a9a37f40f230348bfd11e50aac9861cc8364afaa3f6e91f93ee2647
HELP US WIN ON NOVEMBER 8TH

The future of our families, our children’s education, our livelihoods, and the freedoms enjoyed in this state are all on the line this November.

This is not some extravagant, far-off hypothetical hyperbole.

We’re seeing the destruction being caused in states under the control of Democrat rule in real-time:

▪️ Woke teachers’ unions with free reign to inject children with woke indoctrination and ideologies

▪️ Inappropriate and sexually explicit material readily available in school libraries

▪️ Bureaucrats willing to sacrifice children’s educations to advance their own political futures

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=80d5c931095fbfb01bf9f2c02a2c28cdae443bf60093b89611ced6538a9a37f40f230348bfd11e50aac9861cc8364afaa3f6e91f93ee2647
SEND IN YOUR IMMEDIATE SUPPORT TO HELP US FIGHT BACK

A clear line has been drawn in the sand, Peter.

The far-Left has made clear that they value the demands of radicalized teachers’ unions and the woke mob over the needs of our children and the concerns of parents.

That is unacceptable and woefully backward — and will not fly in Florida as long as my husband is Governor.

Since day one, my husband has been a fighter for Florida families protecting the future of our children, and he will continue fighting because that’s what leaders do.

They step up to the plate and go to battle for the people they serve.

As a father to three young children, no one understands better than my husband what’s truly at stake.

We cannot leave our children’s future and education in the hands of a political party poisoned by woke ideologies and depravity.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=80d5c931095fbfb01bf9f2c02a2c28cdae443bf60093b89611ced6538a9a37f40f230348bfd11e50aac9861cc8364afaa3f6e91f93ee2647
RUSH IN YOUR IMMEDIATE SUPPORT

Our kids deserve better, and they are relying on us to fight for them.

I can tell you my husband will continue that fight every single day — but he can’t do it alone. We are in the final stretch of the campaign, and we need your support now to finish strong.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=80d5c931095fbfb01bf9f2c02a2c28cdae443bf60093b89611ced6538a9a37f40f230348bfd11e50aac9861cc8364afaa3f6e91f93ee2647

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: Peter, this is my story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751192:6SOKFNGNg:m:1:3317145305:ED3F46417235A293EFC9446A51738505:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of
hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751192:6SOKFNGNg:m:1:3317145305:ED3F46417235A293EFC9446A51738505:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751192:6SOKFNGNg:m:1:3317145305:ED3F46417235A293EFC9446A51738505:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751192:6SOKFNGNg:m:1:3317145305:ED3F46417235A293EFC9446A51738505:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751192:6SOKFNGNg:m:1:3317145305:ED3F46417235A293EFC9446A51738505:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751192:6SOKFNGNg:m:1:3317145305:ED3F46417235A293EFC9446A51738505:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751192:6SOKFNGNg:m:1:3317145305:ED3F46417235A293EFC9446A51738505:r "I will always stand up for our
heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751192:6SOKFNGNg:m:1:3317145305:ED3F46417235A293EFC9446A51738505:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751192:6SOKFNGNg:m:1:3317145305:ED3F46417235A293EFC9446A51738505:r "Washingtonians need a voice to find
solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751192:6SOKFNGNg:m:1:3317145305:ED3F46417235A293EFC9446A51738505:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751192:6SOKFNGNg:m:1:3317145305:ED3F46417235A293EFC9446A51738505:r "KEEP
TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751192:6SOKFNGNg:m:1:3317145305:ED3F46417235A293EFC9446A51738505:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751193:6SOKFNGNg:m:1:3317145305:ED3F46417235A293EFC9446A51738505:r "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751193:6SOKFNGNg:m:1:3317145305:ED3F46417235A293EFC9446A51738505:r "Rush support now to be a part of history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---

---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751195:6SOKFNGNg:m:1:3317145305:ED3F46417235A293EFC9446A51738505:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751195:6SOKFNGNg:m:1:3317145305:ED3F46417235A293EFC9446A51738505:r "Step up
now!")**_
