Remember, if you’re planning to vote in person:
* You must be registered to vote in the county where you live. If you are already registered, you can vote at **any** early voting location **in the county you are registered in.**
* If you’re a registered Florida voter who has recently moved to a new county, be sure to update your registered address by contacting your county supervisor of elections or asking for help at your polling location when you go to vote.
* You need to bring a **photo ID** and a **signature ID** when you go to vote. This can be an ID that has both, such as a Florida driver’s license, or a credit card with a signature and a student ID with your picture on it.
* If you experience any problems with early voting, please call the Voter Assistance Hotline at **1-833-VOTE-FLA (1-833-868-3352).**

Thanks again for your support — let’s win this for Florida, together.
– Charlie Crist

subject: Overcoming obstacles

body:
During my recovery, I have learned to never give up.
#

I know that some days the challenges we face in the fight to end gun violence may feel daunting.
But I know a thing or two about overcoming obstacles. After I was shot, nobody knew if I’d ever be able to walk or speak again. But I have never given up on my road to recovery, and today, I am able to do things that nobody thought would be possible 11 years ago.
It hasn’t been easy, but hope has given me the strength to defy the odds. I bring that same hope with me every day in the fight to end gun violence.
[**So if you too believe in the movement to keep our communities safe from gun violence, I’m asking if you can stand with me today and make an investment of $3 or any amount you can afford to Giffords PAC.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct22.6iboAv&refcode=em221028-1-subs&t=1&akid=2678%2E3935704%2EiYIBeH)
In just three days, we’ll be closing out our October fundraising drive. This is our last major fundraising deadline before the midterm elections on November 8th. That means now is our last chance to support candidates who will have the courage to act.
A future with universal background checks and more limited access to assault weapons is within our reach. But we must keep up our work to make this happen. This work starts with ensuring we expand our gun safety majorities in Congress on November 8th.
[**Can I count on you to make a contribution to Giffords PAC today before October comes to an end? I wouldn’t ask if it weren’t so incredibly important.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct22.6iboAv&refcode=em221028-1-subs&t=2&akid=2678%2E3935704%2EiYIBeH)

name: Bradley Whitford
subject: The choice is yours
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
Our country is being torn in two completely different directions, and you have a choice in what happens.
#

Hey there,
It’s Bradley Whitford. You probably know me from The West Wing, and while I’d love to tell you our politics were as idealistic as we experienced in the Bartlet Administration, the truth is things are looking more like The Handmaid’s Tale.
I’ve experienced both of these worlds as an actor, but they’ve both taught me something about our country and democracy: You’re not at the mercy of the future. You can create it.
That’s never been more true than this November. Our country is being torn in two completely different directions, and you have a choice in what happens.
There are the politicians who want to take away our Constitutional rights and who will vote time and time again against democracy, and then there are those of us who are working to secure the same basic rights and freedoms for all of our kids and level the playing field for working families.
That couldn’t be any clearer than in North Carolina’s Senate race. It’s a statistical tie — one of the closest races in the country. But corrupt super PACs are spending massive sums to install a far-right DC insider in this seat.
In our corner, we have Cheri Beasley — a fantastic and inspiring candidate who believes each and every person deserves the opportunity to thrive. She’s the type of strong and compassionate leader that we need more of in Washington.
So here’s the choice: We can let Republicans buy another Senate seat and let Mitch McConnell be in charge of the Senate once again, or we can put our full weight behind Cheri Beasley to make sure she wins this race and expand our majority.
But it is up to you:

Younger voters across central Pennsylvania told PennLive earlier this week that they’re energized and ready to vote. They’re motivated by such issues as education, clean water, and abortion access. “I think right now the biggest hurdle is we are not engaging students in a meaningful way,” Kadida Kenner, of the New Pennsylvania Project, told PennLive.

Pa. election 2022: A basic guide to vetting candidates for U.S. Senate, governor, and more [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2022/09/pa-election-2022-mastriano-shapiro-fetterman-oz-candidates-vetting-guide/] | All eyes will be on Pennsylvania this November election as a number of contentious races on the ballot will determine the state’s political future. [https://www.inquirer.com/politics/election/pennsylvania-voter-registration-data-democrats-republicans-20220928.html] | Republicans are closing a voter registration gap with Democrats, and have added voters in nearly every county over the last two decades, though many have likely been voting Republican for years. (via The Philadelphia Inquirer) [https://www.inquirer.com/politics/election/pennsylvania-voter-registration-data-democrats-republicans-20220928.html]

(via The Philadelphia Inquirer) [https://www.inquirer.com/politics/election/philadelphia-elections-language-expansion-plan-voting-20220928.html]
Pa. election 2022: Where governor candidates Mastriano, Shapiro stand on crime, justice issues [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2022/09/pa-election-2022-mastriano-shapiro-governor-race-crime-prison-bail-reform/] | Month after month, Pennsylvanians cite their safety and related topics — crime, guns, drugs, and violence — as one of the top problems facing the commonwealth. body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=1211%2E5257348%2E6eBgbe ]Adam Schiff for Congress

Derek —

I wanted to share with you a headline from the tossup Senate race between
Democrat Tim Ryan and Republican J.D. Vance in Ohio that really set me
off:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2022_abs_em_ryan.PiRyCh&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20221028_AM1_V1_S1_VSP&email=&t=1004&akid=1211%2E5257348%2E6eBgbe ]NBC News: National Democrats ignore Ohio Senate race, leaving Tim Ryan 'all
by his lonesome'

I don’t usually write emails like this, but it really got to me.

Listen Derek, we can win the Senate race in Ohio. But often the
prognosticators and political handicappers in DC are slow to catch on.

And in this case, it means that the party isn’t buying TV and radio ads,
doing digital work and sending snail mail like it is in other races. And
Tim is left to win by himself.

That’s a real shame. Because Tim is exactly the type of Democrat we need
to win — and can win — in Ohio. He’s a college football star (no seriously
look it up), he speaks about the real needs of the working class, and is
the biggest “Make It in America” cheerleader I know.

Tim also knows how to call out the absolute BS of Republicans better than
any other candidate I know. As Tim so eloquently put it, Ohio doesn’t need
another Republican ass-kisser. (His words, not mine!)

Now, imagine Tim in the Senate. Yeah, that's what I'm thinking, too.

The next two weeks are going to be make or break for Tim Ryan, and our
chances at holding onto both the House and Senate. And to be honest, Tim
could really use your help to win. Even if some national Democrats aren’t
paying attention to his race.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1312?c0=oct2022_abs_em_ryan.EkuOkx&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20221028_AM1_V1_S1_VSP&email=&t=1005&akid=1211%2E5257348%2E6eBgbe ]Can you help Tim fill the fundraising gap, and chip in $10 right now to
both Tim Ryan’s Senate race and our campaign to hold the House?

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split
donation to Tim Ryan and Adam Schiff will go through immediately:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1015?c0=oct2022_abs_em_ryan.RHwiHB&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20221028_AM1_V1_S1_VSP&email=&t=1006&akid=1211%2E5257348%2E6eBgbe ]EXPRESS DONATE $10

# **Newsletter-October 28 Vol. 2, #36**
---
| | |
##
28 October 22

**10 Days Until Election Day!**

THIS IS CRUNCH TIME!

Mail-In Ballots are out. Early voting has begun. Election Day is in 10 days!
We have a lot of work to do! We need your help to get America back on course.

For the first time in 35 years we have an opportunity to make a REAL difference in District 4. Please seize THIS moment!

The Campaign is doing great!

**Radio Ads**
Radio Ads are running through election day on WIHT (Hot 99.5), WAVA (105.1) and WMAL (105.9).
The [30 second generic ad](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=447d494d44&e=12a37459a2) and the [60 sec faith-based ad](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=713a41a38b&e=12a37459a2) are attached. Please share the ads freely with the appropriate audiences.

**Sign Waving**
This Saturday, October 29
Noon-1p
The intersection of Branch Ave & Allentown Rd. (Same place as last week)
Park at Royal Farms parking lot
6210 Allentown Rd, Camp Springs, 20748
FREE JW4C T-shirt provided for those who have not yet received one.
If you have a JW4C T-shirt, please wear it.
Be sure to bring your water bottle.

**Signage**
More signs are going up in the key precincts. We need help to get more signs out...this includes yard signs.
Yard Signs are FREE, yet we are requesting a minimum $10 donation, if you're in a position to donate.
Please contact us at info@JeffWarnerForCongress.com

**Leave Jeff Warner's Pre-Recorded Message To Voters**
The phone calling team is amazing! 36,664 voters have been contacted as of today! Way To Go Team!
Contact Val for the 15 minute training.
443-386-8303

**Final Donations** We are so grateful for the sacrificial support. As we near the end, please consider making a generous contribution. The maximum contribution is $2900 per person. Your donation will help us boost our radio ads and texting. This is especially crucial since Facebook is _discontinuing_ political ads beginning November 1 which is one of the most critical weeks of the campaign.
**Social Media**
Don't miss some of the amazing stories on social media @RepJeffWarner.

**Prayer and Fasting**
If you pray and/or fast, we are asking you to join us in asking God for His perfect will to be done. Please join us on Mondays or whenever works best for you.

We are asking you for your donations, for your service, and your prayers. Together, we can do this! This is the power of teamwork! And the Best Is Yet To Come! Please reach out to us at info@JeffWarnerForCongress.com

In 1 week, the General Election counting will be in process. Let's Get This Done! Together!

[**Donate Here**](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=e1ad08ba03&e=12a37459a2)

Remember, Jeff Warner is standing with you and for you. Enough is Enough! Together, "We The People" can make a real difference. Now is our time to act. THERE IS HOPE!

Standing with you,

subject: Yesterday was not a good day
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alek For Oregon
body:
The only thing I'm guilty of is making my opponent and national Democrats spend money to defend a congressional seat they think belongs to them | [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751405:JutPSNGNs:m:1:3253819041:CD624C7C453E30A6C8990BD59268F995:r)
---
Peter,

Yesterday was not a good fundraising day, and that is putting it lightly. **If I'm being totally honest, it was the worst day of the month so far.**

**Just 22 people donated to the email that I sent out yesterday for a total of $370.** If you read the note yesterday morning, then you may recall that needed that email to raise $10,038, more than**_27 times what we wound up raising by the day's end._**

I don't want to sound like an alarmist, but yesterday's fundraising totals shocked me to the core. We're 11 days out from Election Day and must meet very real fundraising goals to keep our campaign fully funded through November 8th.**If we have another day like yesterday today, tomorrow, or any day left remaining in this campaign, then flipping this seat is probably not going to happen.**

**[Are you able to kick-in $25, $50 or $100 right now to help us make up yesterday's missed fundraising goal?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751405:JutPSNGNs:m:1:3253819041:CD624C7C453E30A6C8990BD59268F995:r)**

Peter, my opponent and Democrat Super PACs are spending more than $1 million to destroy my good name, and it's working. **Two weeks out from Election Day, we're now trailing our opponent by one point**.

Democrats want nothing more than to destroy me. They have held onto this seat since 1972 and **their worst fear is losing it to a 30-year-old Republican**.

**[I'm praying that you'll come through for me today.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751405:JutPSNGNs:m:1:3253819041:CD624C7C453E30A6C8990BD59268F995:r)** We cannot allow this campaign to run of fumes for the last two weeks.

Respectfully,

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-franken?refcode=221028 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-franken?refcode=221028]
Will you split a donation between Admiral Mike Franken's campaign and Seth Moulton today and do your part to flip Iowa from red to blue and protect our Democratic Senate majority? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-franken?refcode=221028]
Friend,
As bombs began raining down on Ukrainian cities, Donald Trump called into Fox News to blame – you guessed it – Joe Biden and Hillary Clinton.
As Russian tanks began pouring over the Ukrainian border, Fox News host Laura Ingraham had the gall to call Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy “pathetic.”
And if you tune into Tucker Carlson these days, you’ll see a show that might as well have been written and produced by Russian state media. Fox News showcases the chasm between traditional GOP normative behavior and the fringe-right cabal now headed by Donald J. Trump.
As the commander of military forces in East Africa, I asked the American Forces Network to replace Fox News during meal hours for troops. Why? Because they were harmful to America's outreach overseas. They put our troops in jeopardy and made my job harder.
Without Fox News, Trump would have only ever been a bungling celebrity who foolishly and laughably ran for president.
Real-time reckoning of lies needs real-time litigation. There is such a thing as gross distortions of fact and purveyors of such must pay a debilitating price. My answer to Fox when I was an admiral in the U.S. Navy? I pulled the plug.
When I defeat Chuck Grassley and turn Iowa blue this November, I will be the most senior military person ever elected to the United States Senate. And I think it’s about time we had more people in leadership who understand the true costs of war and media manipulation of facts, commonly called disinformation.
The polls show we can win. The pundits say we must win. And with your help today, we can fight back against McConnell’s Super PAC lies and protect our Democratic majority in the Senate.
We’ve set a goal of raising another $100,000 before midnight, but right now, we’re still short. If we’re going to defeat Chuck Grassley and turn Iowa blue, I’m counting on grassroots donors like you to give now:
Please, will you split a donation of $27 or more right now between my campaign and Seth Moulton – whatever you can afford before midnight tonight – to help me defeat Chuck Grassley, turn Iowa blue, and protect our Democratic Senate majority? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-franken?refcode=221028]
Fox News’ propaganda cannot go unanswered. But it takes significant funding to run a full-scale campaign and take on all of Grassley’s and McConnell’s lies.
I’m not taking a dime of corporate PAC money, so whatever you can give today will go a long way.
I am so thankful to have you on the team,
Mike Franken, U.S. Navy (ret.)

clean_body: The DNC is counting on grassroots supporters like you to step up once again to help Democrats cross the finish line. | | Derek, you might recognize me as a member of the U.S. Senate, or the former governor of Virginia. A handful of you might know me as the former mayor of Richmond. And I’ll bet some of you know me as the vice presidential nominee in 2016. But you may not know that between those roles, I proudly served as chair of the DNC. What I learned while serving as chair of our party remains true to this day: hundreds of Democratic candidates -- from the very top of the ticket down to the local level -- rely on our national party for vital tools and resources, and this year is no exception. Candidates are relying on our support to help them finish this election strong, which is why I’m coming to you today, Derek. It looks like you haven’t chipped in yet. With just 11 days until Election Day -- and with voters across the country already casting their ballots -- the DNC is counting on your support. Will you be one of 22 more people from Manassas to pitch in $7 to the DNC ahead of Monday’s crucial end-of-month deadline? This is the final fundraising deadline before polls close, so we don’t have a moment to waste. Whether or not we’re able to build on the progress we’ve made depends on our ability to defend our Democratic majorities. That's why it's so urgent that we reach this fundraising goal before Monday's end-of-month deadline. Thanks for your support, Tim Sen. | | **All Tricks, No Treats ⚠️**
---
| |
---
Halloween is this Monday, and while our little goblins (ahem, I mean kiddos) take to the streets to collect sweet treats, a spooky danger threatens their safety. The Boogeyman? Dracula? Elon Musk? Nope. Fentanyl. You read that right. The leading cause of death and the biggest drug epidemic in America has come for our children disguised as [candy.](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=1faa39bdf34347babe24f8aa14a4fbb7&_e=d-fqPZGrqMvO6gs4Kdgnzanosr4un7CCbCLbVL7YmZqCHSfUijRGEbDqCLcaKL4N_jIUPaus9I0Y4_78bHu6LO53zbxWLvTJAVzaw1p9uO4R8vhRbGuZlCY8AFS8lWqe-pr9-VF_4DIElIT9JevkV6TAufVcC25KLThdBDskaEeRn-rn4YKo-53sGjz1WkiKqe_dlyRW-6QsLqH8HCbGjXYbuBjtX8jvaff3hIqzjWkyQGFnFy9xIAc383fx2dnXkhsVpiKbvUsFNqPag3o4hQ%3D%3D) Since August of this year, the [Drug Enforcement Agency (DEA)](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=1faa39bdf34347babe24f8aa14a4fbb7&_e=d-fqPZGrqMvO6gs4KdgnzR2APCym64wjhvPj0hTzn9y1lldIo5zfd5OPYxIQg0tCHH4MI1-SY7XGSL_pLEXwbdTV3hlN7YwL20SfCml-bPvtVtlpZrJbO-UPbWRGxW2ghMoMFngVmCoBNVn-C2_yFPW1DEDPOybzlNbt7ee3M8nBzVbqJtMAVMPfRMCof0A3LpzD9Wj0c_Rm8wxDKWgD7h046SXDcP6rWDaV6GDm3_mXQuJUWKcXEW2xiWf5MAmdIpbeE3ZtJkq9kRbp8xjPZybmdtJEwfycr7p2EJrMZDR-GV0ZU6FKXTlB55xfsu8r) has warned that colorful fentanyl is specifically made to look like candy to our most vulnerable to drive up addiction among kids and young adults. Candy-colored fentanyl and fentanyl pills have been seized in [26 states](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=1faa39bdf34347babe24f8aa14a4fbb7&_e=d-fqPZGrqMvO6gs4Kdgnzc8NG8DPTjGcK_Raosd-iiRTUEoLRTDT6-xTTCIB-nBAm_ZLCR5Mst_6LUfYfq157UPpix4giFJXwq8DO1z-mJOgbNfujIVBQrS-sZ66oS2fI1wDpvc2sN8hMdUTDHzkSMFAmPVd8LTwnS6aJAbf0vfd9k35gUHfNPG4XZWLLfHrnXrCS1hsEFJyabAW4kHctF5FWzDyRM967rIQqJeANrQrWfR8y1L2EKDv146xaq2E4O9Yqm0-Dnmh-uF6CEZ9qGY8xOiaTJLkr1avyv8PBuU7LxbeYD78zADQGo6XYS9ivYltMfgTCjJe_Ze2dmstns4QC53Zd5xVjVgh3zvSnvw%3D) this year alone in all colors, shapes, and sizes. Just this week, fentanyl pills disguised in candy bags were [seized](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=1faa39bdf34347babe24f8aa14a4fbb7&_e=d-fqPZGrqMvO6gs4KdgnzR8DCLnBMXuhg5YrCit-6_210N7ioasAxl8XZDOjnNELhOIZrxK8NX-w4_NS_bd7dPk1aWWUTgKYf4pDjoAbcXvOYj0ewhWuz3L9xfM6l6dNzy7kvlKfmNjp04F_7M63aVu5Iuy9HnJHK9EKBYh7hlw2XQu3EXsXYiJZhWZSkKOVB01N8IKCtVlSlnZov7yJ2wZGTuEfGtx0n_xAXg96I4bmX0nfjRnK8Gb4a3iGAYsOHXXbz3YosWmIteeQFM2zt-udKfuciIiSEsHay0RPBlsAg6b1iHoh-SY6rVmOxmZGNw4p_g65PbHoY0Xft9qIpQ%3D%3D) at the Los Angeles airport. Enough. This is why I am pushing for more severe punishments for drug traffickers with the [Fentanyl Traffic Elimination Act](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=1faa39bdf34347babe24f8aa14a4fbb7&_e=d-fqPZGrqMvO6gs4KdgnzcQAgIWbJw523ij8KfRw4NfwuK1DWq5T5WMFLcxH3y_q7-t71htjU2I5YX2LflV4as6oke5UZIW3F5eqUdt9eWwqH0UQyGgnvI5PpEeRHAOwtYL0ZLNp3lk7XP_VTFfothO66fsiNeuDBI8mgE9gR3B3XkTW2ge3W0FNbvuTNgGkvPPscKqzwE11bLDYf4GdLVmkqeTk28qe1nuF_lSMc_W2IcwQ0YsmPPhz75YcQ741Ed0UzdUiJPSCe_IXVp_aHtesqd3ePW9YwAhLtCj2q0RLgW_nkElXd7W8Vsg1nesA). Come for our kids, and you’ll get the hammer dropped on you. Period. I’ll keep fighting tooth and nail to protect our kids and our communities. Meanwhile, I hope you have a happy Halloween, and stay safe out there folks.

| Hi there,

Election Day is just over one week away, and every day between now and Nov. 8th, voters will choose between Dan and his opponent. **[Click here to help us reach voters before the polls close on November 8th.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53535606/375768772/1325960132?amount=15&contactdata=5XRBvxS8s7IJv1iTd2njLeC2YQ02nTBEdYXG2haH412Cuk9wIjyDKpqBElqougj9rwUuNNM2cBfhw9419dSJAAzBYmENC0c1TLqNIdZHOqRHtGyjA3p3NY%2BLoEWT4EwQWR4TrZ%2BYigUdHn1fur5rUw%3D%3D&refcode2=f4863367-ff56-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&source=EM_NBI_DK_20221028_FR_1.5_0_3MO_campaign_NA_NA_twoweeks&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83Nzg3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNDg2MzM2Ny1mZjU2LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=K44vg0FuXX6ORUWnsnT_wK18TEckiyq-i7EFyWt2uRk=)**

Here are four things every mid-Michigan voter should know before casting their ballot:
* **_Paul Junge and his family got rich off military housing contracts worth hundreds of millions of dollars and he wants to eliminate health care for veterans._** Junge was an executive at the family company, which was sued over and over again, losing in court repeatedly. Veterans and military families deserve better than trust fund millionaire Paul Junge. And, he said health care for our veterans is not “necessary.”

* **_Paul Junge is too extreme for mid-Michigan._** He supports an abortion ban— _with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the mother’s health._ He would team up with National Republican leaders who want to cut funding for Social Security and Medicare, while raising taxes on the middle class. And unlike Dan who is taking on price gouging at the gas pump, _Paul Junge would side with Big Oil companies, because he bought over $100,000 in ExxonMobil stock to make himself richer while you pay more._

* **_Paul Junge is not from here, having spent 43 years outside of Michigan._** He grew up in San Diego—having graduated high school, college, and law school in California. He’s lived outside of Michigan for over four decades and only rented an apartment in Grand Blanc to run for Congress.

* **_Paul Junge is using his million-dollar trust fund to try and buy a seat in Congress._** He has already contributed over $1.7 million of his own money to try and buy this congressional seat, despite not owning a home in mid-Michigan. He’s a multi-millionaire living off his family’s trust fund, who is out of touch with the needs of working families.

This is what we are up against. Elections are a choice, and with Michiganders already voting, we need to make sure everyone in our community knows the real, meaningful differences between Dan and his opponent. Unfortunately, conveying our messages is expensive, and we need your help.

body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

I’m running for Senate because I believe Kentucky is worth fighting for.
And it’s my honor to take this stand with you.

Whenever people tell me they plan to support me, I respond simply: I will
keep earning that support.

I say that because I believe Rand Paul no longer fights for the people of
Kentucky. Instead, he’s using our Commonwealth to feed his ego and
political ambitions.

That’s why he refused to debate me. And it’s why he closed all but one of
his in-state district offices.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18802?t=1001&akid=2678%2E346206%2EycjWI2 ]On November 8th, I plan to send a message to Rand Paul that his time is
up. But to do that, I need you with me: Can you chip in $20 or more to
support my campaign?

DONATE NOW →

If you’ve had reason to be frustrated with our politics, you’re with me.
Together, we’re going to fight together, stand as family, and on November
8th, we’ll win this thing.

Thanks for your support,

Charles

|
Peter,

I wouldn't be reaching out to you so **frantically** _if this wasn 't a dire situation..._ but my Democrat-endorsed opponent is **outraising my campaign** and we're less than two weeks away from Election Day.

[**This critical Senate race could be over unless I hear from you and 15 more conservatives from your area in the next 15 minutes.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61752963:6Q3W4NGtN:m:1:3364136623:8764163BBDB25A38F0C11F84C42634D9:r)

Now is not the time to fall behind - **too much is at stake in this election for us to lose.** I called my team and asked them what I can do to pick up the pace. Their response? **REACH OUT TO YOU, Peter.**

[**Please, answer my call today and rush in your support.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61752963:6Q3W4NGtN:m:1:3364136623:8764163BBDB25A38F0C11F84C42634D9:r) If I win - Republicans will win back the Senate majority. **If I lose** - well, you know. We can't let that happen.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61752963:6Q3W4NGtN:m:1:3364136623:8764163BBDB25A38F0C11F84C42634D9:r)
[ ** TAKE ACTION ➞ **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61752963:6Q3W4NGtN:m:1:3364136623:8764163BBDB25A38F0C11F84C42634D9:r)

The Democrats are determined to win in Utah. Chuck Schumer knows a WIN here is the ONLY WAY the left can hold their majority.

**My campaign is being outraised** and time is running out before Election Day. This is the time when critical ad placements are made and without money in the bank - my opponent will be able to reach more voters at a crucial stage in this race.

[**Please, Peter, I need to hear from you and 15 other conservatives from your area in the next 15 minutes or this race could over.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61752963:6Q3W4NGtN:m:1:3364136623:8764163BBDB25A38F0C11F84C42634D9:r)

Help me win and help Republicans take back the Senate majority. **I 'm counting on hearing from you.**

For America,
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61752964:6Q3W4NGtN:m:1:3364136623:8764163BBDB25A38F0C11F84C42634D9:r)
Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

subject: Have you seen what they're doing to our kids?
body:
| | | Dear Peter, We have the key to stop our children from being corrupted by the radical Left in our schools -- and I need your immediate help to win... [**That 's why I'm asking you to make an emergency donation of $35 or more today.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751809:JzNl4NGcN:m:1:3372576248:4D2BB5B8E7F582CBA87D28A83AAE3D7F:r) We recently filed suit against a school AND the activists pretending to be teachers to make them pay for what they're doing to our young and vulnerable children. Because the ONLY way we're going to stop them -- is to make these extremists pay for their crimes... And that's exactly what our landmark lawsuit does! Let me quickly give you the details in case you missed us while we were on **Laura Ingraham** 's great **Fox News **show talking about our case: Jessica Konen, the mother of an innocent 12-year-old girl, was called into her daughter's school and told that her daughter was now a "boy". She found out that her young daughter had been groomed into believing she was "transgender" and "bisexual"... Her impressionable daughter didn't even know these words until they were forced on her by these radicals. The school then pushed Jessica's innocent daughter to create a whole new identity -- complete with a new boy's name, new pronouns and had her use a different bathroom... They also created a "Gender Support Plan" and ordered the faculty to use her new name and pronouns -- all without her mother's knowledge! **And Jessica had no idea because her young daughter was told NOT to tell her mother since she couldn 't be "trusted"****.**
* These people are not real teachers.
* They're not concerned with teaching our children to read...
* They're not concerned with teaching our children math and arithmetic...
* They're not concerned with teaching history...

They want to indoctrinate an entire generation of children to reject their parent's values and embrace their radical Left-Wing propaganda -- and we have to stop them. [**That 's why I'm asking you to rush in your donation of $35 or more to help us stop these child groomers now. **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751809:JzNl4NGcN:m:1:3372576248:4D2BB5B8E7F582CBA87D28A83AAE3D7F:r) After all this, Jessica did what any good mother would do and questioned the principal about what was happening to her young daughter at school... ... And what happened next? Child Protective Services was called to her house and "interviewed" her children! This grooming is happening behind closed doors in classrooms across the country... And it's happening in secret so parents, grandparents and the community don't know what's going on. Jessica's innocent daughter is just one of the countless victims -- and if we don't act, there will be more and more every day... Since we announced our lawsuit **The Ingraham Angle** , tons of concerned parents, grandparents and teachers have reached out to us. It's horrible and sickening that this is happening, but we have to stop it... And our lawsuit is the key. Political pressure and new laws will not work -- we must drag these radical activists and schools into court and make them pay. That's why our lawsuit names the individual "teachers" \-- we must hold **them** accountable... Only when these extremists are scared of being dragged into court and are forced to pay will they stop. Make no mistake -- if we win this landmark case every single one of these so-called teachers will take notice. They will think of the consequences before pushing their radical agenda on our vulnerable children... [**So please, join me today with a donation of $35 or more to fund our lawsuit to protect our kids from out of control leftist teachers.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751809:JzNl4NGcN:m:1:3372576248:4D2BB5B8E7F582CBA87D28A83AAE3D7F:r) But to stop them, we need to win this case... And if you can give more today - $50, $100, $250 or more - I will use it to protect our children and our constitutional rights from these radical Left extremists. But, whatever amount you can send, I ask that you rush it in right away. And please know that here at the Center for American Liberty we don't just file lawsuits - we **WIN** them!! We recently won three major victories for religious liberty before the U.S. Supreme Court and we're fighting Big Tech and the politicians who are conspiring to silence and destroy conservatives... But this case to stop these extremists from corrupting and damaging our innocent children is too important to lose. And the only way to stop them is to make them know we're going to make them pay for their actions... [**So please, join the fight today****with your emergency tax-deductible donation of $20, $35, $50, $100 or more today.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61751809:JzNl4NGcN:m:1:3372576248:4D2BB5B8E7F582CBA87D28A83AAE3D7F:r) We're ready to go to the mat to win this case, but we can't do it without you. Thank you in advance for your support. Sincerely,

**New Funding Grant Highlights Campaign Season ** **Trickery and the Lack of Progress for CT **
**FAIRFIELD, CT** \- Yesterday, U.S. Congressman Himes announced grant funding for a non-profit program in Bridgeport. While the program itself is laudable, the timing of the grant, a mere ten days before the General Election is suspect and belies the limited results achieved for CT in his last 14 years in Congress. **It’s time for change! **
**Statement from Jayme Stevenson on the lack of federal funds returning to CT:**
“It is clear that the State of CT is dead last in federal funds coming back to CT. For every dollar sent to D.C., CT receives only $0.95 back to our state. This helps to explain why CT still has not recovered all the jobs it lost during the great recession. clean_body: | | | | Today is the 10-year anniversary of superstorm Sandy that devastated not only CT, but the entire tri-state area. As Darien’s First Selectman for over a decade, through hurricanes, floods and a global pandemic, not once did Himes reach out to see how we were doing. jaymestevensonforcongress.com New Funding Grant Highlights Campaign Season Trickery and the Lack of Progress for CT FAIRFIELD, CT \- Yesterday, U.S. Congressman Himes announced grant funding for a non-profit program in Bridgeport. While the program itself is laudable, the timing of the grant, a mere ten days before the General Election is suspect and belies the limited results achieved for CT in his last 14 years in Congress. It’s time for change! Statement from Jayme Stevenson on the lack of federal funds returning to CT: “It is clear that the State of CT is dead last in federal funds coming back to CT. For every dollar sent to D.C., CT receives only $0.95 back to our state. This helps to explain why CT still has not recovered all the jobs it lost during the great recession. In 2022, we are facing runaway inflation while salaries in CT have not kept up and another looming recession. “CT residents have real concerns that are not being addressed. My hands-on experience as a local, regional and state leader makes me uniquely qualified to address our most pressing public policy issues facing CT. As your next Congresswoman, I pledge to work every day for ALL municipalities in the district. CT did not receive FEMA disaster recovery resources and reimbursements on a timely basis. Himes’ office. “CT can no longer afford to have feckless leadership that squanders precious federal funding resources needed to protect our towns and cities from severe weather events. It is time to send a new leader to Congress that will not only secure funds needed for our 17 municipalities in the fourth district, but will also collaborate to ensure that funds procured are put to use and capital projects are completed. “It is time to expect more from your leader in Congress. I will serve the residents of CT, not party leaders in DC. On November 8, I hope to have earned your vote and will champion a brighter future for all in Connecticut.” | THE GOOD NEWS? We’re CLOSER THAN EVER to VICTORY! With this, your support is needed TO CLOSE THE GAP. ! | | | Friends, today, Mike Van Someren released a plan for our environment. It is called: **PRIORITIZE ENVIRONMENTAL STEWARDSHIP ...
WHILE INCENTIVIZING GREEN ECONOMIC INNOVATION.**
[Click here to read the whole plan](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=ddaf158415&e=356c0699dd)
“We need to protect Wisconsin’s beautiful natural resources, and we can be innovative to ensure families can continue to enjoy our quality of life while we do right by the planet,” said Mike.

“It’s not a choice between the economy and the environment – our strategy should be to grow our economy BY protecting our natural environment and addressing climate change. That’s how we make Wisconsin, and America, stronger.”

**Mike’s opponent still refuses to debate, or even talk with any citizens who disagree with his hard-right extremist vision. But Mike is still working to lay out a vision for a better America.

[This is our last chance to get the message out. Please donate today by clicking here.](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=df51084270&e=356c0699dd)**

Mike Van Someren’s plan includes four key pillars: Stewardship of Natural Resources, Green Technology Jobs, Green Energy Infrastructure, and Sustainable Family Farming. Similar to his economic plan, the vision prioritizes working families over the super wealthy and megacorporations. His plan is rooted in socially and environmentally-conscious, market-based approaches that will return the middle class to generating the majority of our nation’s income while ensuring we protect the planet for future generations.

“Whether it is adding clean nuclear energy to the clean energy mix alongside geothermal, solar, and wind, or it is reprioritizing family farming, we simply need to return to our most basic Wisconsin values in order to prepare for the future,” said Mike.

We’ve got just 12 days. Mike has laid out plans for our democracy, for public safety, for the economy, and now for our environment.

[Please support him with a contribution today. ](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=4abeb62b0a&e=356c0699dd)

Peter**,** Jennifer Wexton has a problem with parents.

She endorsed a radical candidate who believes parents should be _thrown in jail_ for not adhering to the pronouns their children’s school chooses for them.

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

There are 3 days until our final fundraising deadline before Election Day, and it’s never been more important to have your support
#

There are 3 days until our final fundraising deadline before Election Day, and it’s never been more important to have your support.
Here are 3 reasons why Cheri Beasley needs you to donate $3 today:
1. This week, two new polls were released, and both showed the race in a statistical tie. This race could come down to a handful of votes — just like Cheri’s race for Chief Justice was decided by 401 votes.
2. Right-wing outside groups are spending over $63 million to try to buy this seat for Ted Budd. North Carolina is one of Republican super PACs’ largest investments in the entire country, and we cannot let them drown us out.
3. If we flip North Carolina, Cheri Beasley will expand the majority and cast the decisive vote to defend abortion rights, protect voting rights, raise wages and lower costs, and more!

Small-dollar donations are critical to funding our GOTV efforts. So your $3 can make a big impact in the final week of early voting.

Many of you know the story. When Lisa was elected to Congress, she wanted to wear something special to commemorate the history that we all made together. We were all discussing options when our sister Thea came up with an idea. She had been doing research on our family and found our great-great-great grandfather’s voting card. To a former slave turned sharecropper, that card, with just an X for his name, represented a broken barrier and a renewed sense of hope for the direction of our nation. To Lisa, it serves as a continuous reminder of just how far we’ve come and how much farther we must go, and she carries it with her both mentally and physically, in the form of a scarf, as a tribute to his legacy and the people who have entrusted her to serve.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53541848/375789409/-1113401298?refcode=EM_FR_2201028Marla_EOM_MBC_90DO_7_NG_TESTB_image&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMzVkZjMwMi0xMTU3LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WhHKaHcwkk4JYSwdxcgMA3V-9M7BFg1Jvc7y-m5XVXs=) **[Lisa is ready to continue building a brighter future that we can all be proud of, but she can’t do it alone. This November’s election is our chance to reject extremism and continue our path forward toward a democracy where we are all represented. Will you pitch in $10 now to show support for Lisa and help us win big before our October deadline?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53541850/375789411/-1113401298?refcode=EM_FR_2201028Marla_EOM_MBC_90DO_7_NG_TESTBL1&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMzVkZjMwMi0xMTU3LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WhHKaHcwkk4JYSwdxcgMA3V-9M7BFg1Jvc7y-m5XVXs=)** [DONATE NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53541852/375789413/-1113401298?refcode=EM_FR_2201028Marla_EOM_MBC_90DO_7_NG_TESTB_B1&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMzVkZjMwMi0xMTU3LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WhHKaHcwkk4JYSwdxcgMA3V-9M7BFg1Jvc7y-m5XVXs=) Our nation has transformed so much in the time since my great-great-great grandfather gained the right to vote, but democracy is a continual work in progress. Stagnation is not an option, team. Too many people are depending on our progress for us to give up and allow it all to be reversed.

Whether it’s the continued fight for voting accessibility, the right to bodily autonomy, protections for LGBTQ+ students and teachers, or the race to keep climate change at bay, the lives of our citizens and our country’s future are too great for us to risk on leaders who won’t take action and stand up for their constituents.

clean_body: And forward is the only way worth going. = = Folks, My sister’s journey to Congress has been years in the making, and not just in the traditional sense. Many of you know the story. When Lisa was elected to Congress, she wanted to wear something special to commemorate the history that we all made together. We were all discussing options when our sister Thea came up with an idea. She had been doing research on our family and found our great-great-great grandfather’s voting card. To a former slave turned sharecropper, that card, with just an X for his name, represented a broken barrier and a renewed sense of hope for the direction of our nation. To Lisa, it serves as a continuous reminder of just how far we’ve come and how much farther we must go, and she carries it with her both mentally and physically, in the form of a scarf, as a tribute to his legacy and the people who have entrusted her to serve. = = = Our nation has transformed so much in the time since my great-great-great grandfather gained the right to vote, but democracy is a continual work in progress. Stagnation is not an option, team. Too many people are depending on our progress for us to give up and allow it all to be reversed. Whether it’s the continued fight for voting accessibility, the right to bodily autonomy, protections for LGBTQ+ students and teachers, or the race to keep climate change at bay, the lives of our citizens and our country’s future are too great for us to risk on leaders who won’t take action and stand up for their constituents. Peter, My experiences as a nurse are the reason why I’m running for Congress. For over 28 years, I’ve been providing health care to Minnesota’s senior citizens; workers; Black, Brown, and Indigenous people; and women and children. I have even treated patients with COVID-19 to provide the essential care they needed at the height of the pandemic.

In Congress, I will be a champion for nurses and frontline workers because I know that they’re still fighting to protect all of us. I’ll fight for accessible, affordable health care and lower prescription drug costs so no one has to choose between getting the care they need or picking up groceries that week. And as a nurse anesthetist, I make decisions every day based on science and facts. That’s why I’ll support policies that will stop climate change and end this pandemic to keep our communities safe. Minnesota’s Sixth Congressional District deserves a fighter. And no one fights harder than a nurse. We are less than two weeks away from Election Day, and I’m ready to bring our Minnesota values to Congress. **[If you’re able, donate today to help my campaign in this final stretch of this race, so I can fight for Minnesotans in Congress.](http://clicksp.hendricks2022.com/f/a/3_LKb2jwSn3zGhZhXnXaeA~~/AAPPAAA~)**

| | **_It is my honor to receive another endorsement from Pennsylvania law enforcement. Thank you, Berks County FOP Lodge 71, for your trust and your support_.**

**I cannot thank our admirable men and women in law enforcement strongly enough for everything they do – even as Madeleine Dean's leadership makes every effort to stop them. **Because of Democrats' defund-the-police and open-borders agenda, law enforcement officers’ jobs are made much more difficult.

Throughout this campaign, my opponent has made it clear that she believes our local police are the problem. **_I believe they are heroes and they are the only solution we have to keep our communities and our families safe_.**

[](https://cn4pa.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2d1d8e72981035507cd4628e7&id=cddf916557&e=0a4d873a55) **Both the Berks County and Montgomery County Lodges of the Fraternal Order of Police support our campaign** because we know that criminals must be prosecuted and law and order must prevail in our neighborhoods. I am humbled by these endorsements and pledge to work with the brave men and women of law enforcement to protect our families and keep our streets, small businesses, and schools safe. We need more leaders who are not afraid to stand up for what's right. Who are not afraid to say that bad people should be locked up. Who are not afraid to say that police officers make our communities stronger, safer, better.

**Thank you for your hard work.[_Thank you for your support_](https://cn4pa.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2d1d8e72981035507cd4628e7&id=5c0ea9d46d&e=0a4d873a55). Thank you for your contribution to my campaign.**

We need principled leadership in Washington now more than ever. **Let's win this race! **

\- Christian Nascimento

Jasmine and I met in 2004.
When we started dating, we navigated issues familiar to any LGBTQ person or couple – the daily choices about when and how to come out, the assessment of whether it was safe to hold hands in public. But we knew then and now that love is stronger than hate.
Four years later, we wanted to get married. We chose to have our ceremony in Asheville in front of our family and friends, even though our marriage was banned by law. It was where we had met and a place that was special to both of us. It is where we dreamed of creating a family and building our future together, no matter that the law did not recognize our family. It is home.
We got married on a beautiful August day in 2008. In the years that followed, we set out to make sure that LGBTQ people across the South could feel at home in their own hometowns.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53530213/375746589/299178295?refcode=EM_BS_JAS_221028_FR_WifeJasmine_A0_na_U3_X3&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODg4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNTVlODA4Zi1mMzU2LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8SV8lSrQfh1Xr1xGqMWpcelmtG5mmc5bQwQ6KDqfqa4=)
Together, we organized a multi-state push for marriage equality at a time when many people said it was impossible.
Right now, she’s committed to delivering love, hope, and empathy to our district and to defeating extremist Chuck Edwards. The decision to get into this race was a family decision, and this is a family campaign.
It’s about fighting for the kind of politics and policies that embrace the ideals of love and empathy. It’s about creating a kind of politics where there’s room for everyone at the table. I have no doubt that we are going to get this done together – us as a family, and with all of you.

In the years that followed, we set out to make sure that LGBTQ people across the South could feel at home in their own hometowns. = Together, we organized a multi-state push for marriage equality at a time when many people said it was impossible. Right now, she’s committed to delivering love, hope, and empathy to our district and to defeating extremist Chuck Edwards. The decision to get into this race was a family decision, and this is a family campaign. It’s about fighting for the kind of politics and policies that embrace the ideals of love and empathy. It’s about creating a kind of politics where there’s room for everyone at the table. I have no doubt that we are going to get this done together – us as a family, and with all of you. Right now, Jasmine is working hard to hit her last end-of-month goal before Election Day.= | | = | | = I know your support means the world to Jasmine. clean_body: | | | Peter – my team just let me know that we're falling incredibly short of our critical midnight fundraising goal. If you have a second, I'd like to tell you why it's so essential to our campaign – and our progressive future – that we reach this goal and raise what we need now. The truth is that the odds are against us. With the Senate split 50-50, the GOP needs to flip just one seat to retake control for Mitch McConnell, and experts report that I'm the most vulnerable Senate Democrat in the entire country. Republicans are coming after me as their top target for defeat – and they've already started launching attack ads to try and crush our people-powered movement. I won't let them – but I need your help. I'm not taking a cent of corporate PAC money – and unlike GOP megadonors, I don't have millions to sink into my campaign. I've got this grassroots team – and right now, the only way I can fight back against these attacks and defend my seat is with your urgent support. That means hitting critical fundraising goals like this one. So I'll be direct, Peter: I'm asking you to make a contribution – here and now – toward our midnight fundraising goal before it's too late. This will be one of the most competitive Senate races of the cycle, and we simply can't afford to fall behind before we even get started. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = = = = = = This team has helped us beat the odds before, and I know we can do it again. body:
I can’t overstate how important this upcoming election is.

| I’ve served my country in the Navy, at NASA, and now in the Senate.

No matter where I’ve been or what I was doing, I’ve always used science, data, and facts to make tough decisions.

And right now, the facts tell me that we’re in trouble.

National Republicans are attacking the right to abortion, denying the devastating impact climate change is having on our planet, and spreading misinformation about the integrity of our elections nationwide. **But I refuse to let them win.**

I didn’t spend more than 54 days in space observing the damage climate change is wreaking on our planet just for far-right extremists to deny the truth and refuse to take action. I think our leaders should follow the facts, listen to the science, and act decisively — [_**will you split a donation of $5 between my campaign and Fight for Progress if you agree?**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/53531708/375752423/-437599628?refcode=BLU-JRFC-20221028-1-EM&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjNhZWUzOGNmLWY2NTYtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGQyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=7jcvnNL7nyjJ5d-W5RQs7wuOGHmrnEDNwOX5j0T8ets=)

I didn’t serve 25 years in the Navy just for Republicans to threaten our country from within by sowing doubt and misinformation about the integrity of our elections. Our leaders should respect the will of the voters and free and fair elections — [_**if you agree, will you split a $5 donation between my campaign and Fight for Progress?**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/53531709/375752424/-437599628?refcode=BLU-JRFC-20221028-1-EM&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjNhZWUzOGNmLWY2NTYtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGQyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=7jcvnNL7nyjJ5d-W5RQs7wuOGHmrnEDNwOX5j0T8ets=)

Science, data, and facts have helped me solve some of the most difficult challenges in my life. And I think we need more members of Congress who are willing to put politics aside and do the same.

Peter,

Yesterday was not a good fundraising day, and that is putting it lightly. **If I’m being totally honest, it was the worst day of the month so far.**

**Just 22 people donated to the email that I sent out yesterday for a total of $370.** If you read the note yesterday morning, then you may recall that needed that email to raise $10,038– more than**_27 times what we wound up raising by the day’s end._**

I don’t want to sound like an alarmist, but yesterday’s fundraising totals shocked me to the core. body:
I am asking for your support to help defeat Ron Johnson.

---
Friends -

My path to running for U.S. Senate was different than most. I don't come from a wealthy family. I didn't enter this race with a bunch of mega-donors lining up to write big checks to this campaign.

My mom was a public school teacher and my dad worked third shift at General Motors. Those jobs were our family's ticket to the middle class.

Ever since I was a little kid, my parents taught me never to settle for what is, but to reach for what can be. It was how I graduated high school at the age of 16 and went on to be elected to the Wisconsin State Assembly when I was 25. And it's how I won Wisconsin’s Lieutenant Governor race in 2018 and helped beat Scott Walker.
Then, after careful thought and consideration, I decided to get in this U.S. Senate race to defeat Ron Johnson.

It was a big decision. I knew that this was going to be one of the most competitive races in the entire country. And it is a race that we must win if we're going to defend and expand the Democratic Senate majority.

I was willing to bet that if I decided to run, people like you would come together in large numbers to help fund this campaign. And I'm so grateful to have your support. Because the truth is that no single person can flip Wisconsin's Senate seat alone. It will only happen if we're in this together.

Hi Derek,

Our first debate just wrapped on TV. I hope I made you, and our entire people-powered team, proud.

I was able to share with voters my fight for our common good and all that it entails: making more stuff here and reigning in unchecked corporate greed, lowering costs, protecting the union way of life, protecting a woman’s right to an abortion, making healthcare not such a ripoff, and so much more.

I also got to confront my opponent on his radical and dangerous beliefs, and his history of coddling our economic foes in China. I’m not afraid to take on anyone hurting working families in western Pennsylvania, and that includes corporate executive Jeremy Shaffer. And I’m certainly not going to sit by while he welcomes support from traitors and insurrectionists who tried to overthrow the very government I swore an oath to defend.

Derek, there are just 11 days to go until the election, and everything is on the line. Can you chip in tonight to help me defeat Shaffer?

subject: Why I left the Democratic Party
body:
It was unrecognizable. | | | [](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=3e1c9c6b9d&e=fdefed58de)
---
PeterHi, it’s Tulsi Gabbard, former Democratic Congresswoman and former Vice Chair of the Democratic National Committee.I recently left the Democratic Party because it’s under the complete control of an elitist cabal of warmongers driven by cowardly “wokeness.”
[](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=d79c8aa928&e=fdefed58de)
Democrats have gone insane with ideological fanaticism, and to put it plainly, the Democratic Party that I joined doesn’t exist anymore.[**Today, I’m proud to endorse John Gibbs for Congress in Michigan’s 3rd District.**](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=b1c447a9c5&e=fdefed58de) John is a leader who puts people first, is fighting for border security, energy independence, public safety, and other policies that actually make life better for the American people.
My parents were married in East Grand Rapids, which is my mother’s hometown. This district and John’s race matter to me. [**So I hope you’ll join me today in supporting John’s campaign with a generous gift.**](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=4da7b5dc61&e=fdefed58de)
John isn’t afraid to call out permanent Washington and the propagandists in the mainstream media who aim to keep them in power.Our country is in desperate need of leaders like John who will stand up for the objective truth and bring the fight directly to the dogmatic fanaticism of ideologues leading the Democratic Party.[**Please join me in supporting John’s campaign here.**](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=5044a5248e&e=fdefed58de)
With aloha,Tulsi Gabbard

name: Erin Mincberg
subject: Our biggest challenge yet:
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
The election is underway here in Texas, and our final end-of-month deadline of the election is Monday, so I want to take a second to reflect on how far we’ve come.
We’ve done so much this year as a team. We’ve introduced Lizzie to a redrawn district where 70% of voters are new, starting with the primary election in March where we knocked on doors and sent mail to many households. We’ve worked hard to get people familiar with Lizzie and her work in Congress. Over the past few months, we’ve knocked on thousands of doors, put an important message from Lizzie on TV and kept it on the air, sent mail to many thousands of households, and built an incredibly strong campaign.
During this time, we’ve also faced big challenges in our state and our country. We’ve witnessed dangerous rollbacks to our freedoms, including Texas’ S.B. 8 going into effect and the overturning of Roe v. Wade .
All of that reinforces the importance of this year’s elections and electing leaders like Lizzie who are fighting for our rights, freedoms, and values — true Texas priorities.
We’ve come a long way. Now, we need to finish strong and your generous contributions help us do that. Please contribute whatever you can before our end-of-October deadline on Monday. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221028?refcode=lpfe221028]
Thanks,
Erin

We missed our $5,800 goal yesterday by just $716. We're getting on more chance to redeem our $5,800 match, but we have to hit our goal by 11:59 p.m. I know you are busy enjoying what’s left of your weekend, so I’ll try to be quick! |
---
Peter

I want to apologize for emailing you twice in one day, but with just 11 days remaining in this election, this couldn’t wait. **Before you click out of this, or God forbid delete the message before reading it in its entirety, please know that your support at this critical juncture could mean the difference between another two years of DEM control in the House or helping it flip Republican.**

I’m nothing if not honest. I have my faults as we all do, but a liar I am not. You likely recall the email that I sent to you yesterday laying out in no uncertain terms that our fundraising this month hasn’t been good at all – in fact, Tuesday marked our single worst day of donations in the last six months. **As a result, a very generous benefactor offered to cut my campaign a check for $5,800 under the condition that I came up with an additional $5,800 from donors like you by midnight last evening**.
**
We failed. In the end, we came up short by $716.[[link to donate]](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=8aae6805ab334381ab367e2e0669b7fa&_e=t58T1qdP9lK1c8Fa1ecaJfj-uYQyJuJ311ojtmwv4DqwzDRH_CPJ8GmcAtE7CLbEavfoS5tP8ZsQ7ies7jNt1t1HDzDdLWfU-6R2Zt2L9aGHbC2jpSZxWiiL-Gddz3SmrQ6_RLJG4b_x1dzMdtkeC4AKiDJkQtOcVMVJb6uWs-eoxUmVaK1HLYL6-Fau-G1i_O5Zr-wj42LwsMEoh2Xqc2gwxeKnQjCVaNEmlXmH2Z6N4VhP2jY2cDqVZMZnGMwV7M_d9BviSfSo3SkKIqRtGpglFfr_v6Nk0mk3FWMv32TRhtiP1xJ2_ocgBvVF8jDtCm8ksLt2NyEXFYBiRGXwJDAC71es7vZ6sbCVrV6qabm9j4yK6jtUGdSUfeU4McNw) **

All is not lost – yet. The donor, who wishes to remain anonymous, has agreed to give us one more shot at winning his support. If we can come up with the additional $716 by midnight tonight, he’ll follow through with his part of the bargain and cut us the $5,800 check.

According to _Bloomberg_ , US profit margins are the widest they've been since 1950, which suggests that the prices being set by corporations are far outpacing their actual expenses. clean_body: This is about as out-of-touch as it gets. | | Peter, We had to share this quote from our opponent Esther King -- because it really highlights her values and core philosophy. At a recent campaign event, King claimed that “corporate greed is a made up explanation” for what’s causing inflation. This is about as out-of-touch as it gets, folks. According to Bloomberg , US profit margins are the widest they've been since 1950, which suggests that the prices being set by corporations are far outpacing their actual expenses. It’s true that the cost of running a business has risen, but some corporations aren't simply passing those costs down to consumers -- they’re price-gouging. This isn’t some "made up" myth, and Congress should actually be holding these corporations accountable. Esther King is showing us what she really believes, and we should all take her word for it. If elected, she’ll defend corporations that exploit working-class Illinoisans. On the other hand, Eric is aware that corporate greed exists and must be reined in. Esther King is taking big money from Kevin McCarthy’s super PAC and fossil fuel companies. That should tell you everything you need to know about where her loyalties stand. Peter

I want to apologize for emailing you twice in one day, but with just 11 days remaining in this election, this couldn’t wait. **Before you click out of this, or God forbid delete the message before reading it in its entirety, please know that your support at this critical juncture could mean the difference between another two years of DEM control in the House or helping it flip Republican.**

I’m nothing if not honest. I have my faults as we all do, but a liar I am not. You likely recall the email that I sent to you yesterday laying out in no uncertain terms that our fundraising this month hasn’t been good at all – in fact, Tuesday marked our single worst day of donations in the last six months. **As a result, a very generous benefactor offered to cut my campaign a check for $5,800 under the condition that I came up with an additional $5,800 from donors like you by midnight last evening**.
**
We failed. In the end, we came up short by $716.[[link to donate]](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=656f4b47664845da876bb6d7491e91b4&_e=XUasN1pr_Zgh5_HVy5XXDLj87Efc54ZIuLA7c4bR_rFO2_HPlu0GGOR_Uikj-xgAiv4A-6o8kmjyJy8jxrNyQ8674avjc8HUZcDG3kLdcHNXrQxrk7Auadd30CMBa-ldMQazUAp4a97CfaqeTH_McDwiUpQhn7zkKleK8LV6yp2W_0LCW_LbuS1Xb_OI3BUREEtc0rSkcBa-F5YGpoqJdP-SFQJRLbJTN_cyFKDVKTVFR0EnPFVJ-H5hRBXQov5DqQQg1GPDfZTmB2M6apNPiMiWq7Vvezh_pVupeE9S5yeOcXC8bGNzVoEjPVuDNC2W2HKAqJolgrQ90ZeJe8wp5pd9fZ5n6C7nNt0KDEyifUKAUa2ETnF1-qICHZDoYDcy) **

So, why vote for / donate to us? Because: We help families, not hurt them; We will vote for you, not against you.We support workers and small businesses.We enjoy the environment. We prefer safe drinking water and fresh air.We know no one should suffer without health care.We support women’s rights.We know children are our future and need to be nourished, cherished, and educated.We want our elected officials to represent what is the best of us, not the worse. Need more reasons to vote? Consider
People with diabetes rationing insulin or cancer patients going bankrupt–this isn’t who we are as Americans, especially Yoopers.
We need Broadband to thrive economically, for our students to learn and for our enjoyment. Even in some areas, we need cell phone coverage to call 911 We must create a brighter future for Disheartened young adults
* Will they ever be able to own a home?
* Will they have a better future than their grandparents and parents?
* Are education and training available and affordable?
* Will there be good jobs to enable them to stay in the UP?
* We need to restore their enthusiasm and hope
* We problem-solve.
* We want to unite, not divide.

Any other reason to vote?
* Our rural hospitals’ and schools' very existence is threatened, and we will fight to keep them and improve them.

* Jobs are dwindling, and we will create more of them.

* We will protect the Environment and the beauty where we live, work and play.

* We understand there is a severe housing shortage.

It is everywhere we go with families, children, businesses, and communities all suffering, and we will work together–locally, in Lansing and in DC to make it possible to live here.

* We understand the lack of childcare and pre-primary education is a national disgrace, and we will work to protect our future by investing in our future-our children.

* We will fix and pay for social security and Medicare not ignore it, privatize it or destroy it

* And yes will all believe in a strong economy, safe communities, and fighting inflation unlike the lies from our opponents.

I am running for Congress to bring integrity, truth-telling, and honest leadership back to Washington, DC, representing the best of who we are and want to become, not the worst. I want to champion rural America nationally and here, where I live, work, play and worship. I promise to listen and learn, serve and respect, and problem solve, unite, and represent all of us in the 1st District, Michigan, and our Nation. I will vote for us when it matters most unlike my opponent.

# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20221028-3544-header&t=1&akid=3544%2E2526796%2EVZF2wQ)
Is there anything we can say to [earn your first $3 contribution to power Alexandria’s campaign to win another term in Congress?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221028.dXr5lB&refcode=em20221028-3544-P_FND_EOM_OPP&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3544%2E2526796%2EVZF2wQ)

What if we told you Alexandria’s opponent is hosting $500 fundraising dinners across the country?
What if we told you we're taking on our MAGA opponent without a cent from corporate PACs because this movement is 100% powered by grassroots supporters?
A donation of $3 may not seem like a lot of money compared to Republican corporate mega-donors and super PACs — but when we put all of our grassroots donations together, it amounts to a really powerful movement. **For years, we’ve been the #1 small-dollar funded campaign in Congress, so we're really hoping we can rely on supporters like you.**
[Please, will you make a donation today to power our campaign to make Alexandria the representative for NY-14 in the next Congress? $3 goes a long way when everyone is chipping in.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221028.dXr5lB&refcode=em20221028-3544-P_FND_EOM_OPP&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=3544%2E2526796%2EVZF2wQ)

[Our end-of-month fundraising deadline is Monday at midnight, so your donation today will go _directly_ toward re-electing Alexandria and defeating right-wing fascists in NY-14 once and for all.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221028.dXr5lB&refcode=em20221028-3544-P_FND_EOM_OPP&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=3544%2E2526796%2EVZF2wQ)

Team AOC

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: THE most important election
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
We can’t let the Republicans win and destroy everything we’ve built.
#
Peter,
**11 days from now** , voters will decide the results of THE most important election in recent history. In order to do everything we can to keep Democrats in control of Congress, we’ve set a monthly goal to **raise $75,000 by midnight on Monday.**
If we get there, we can go all out to make sure the GOP doesn’t win.
Because honestly, the Republicans could win. They could win the House, the Senate, and statewide races. We can’t stop every Republican running for Congress, but we CAN stop them from retaking control. And we have to.
[**So we’re asking you to join us in this fight and chip in anything you can — $5, $27, or more. We have 11 days left until this critical election, and only 3 until our monthly fundraising deadline. Can we count on your donation right now?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/21113?refcode=em20221028-1772&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=1772%2E420207%2Edizu2H)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/21113?refcode=em20221028-1772&t=20&akid=1772%2E420207%2Edizu2H)**
**The House Democratic majority is the #1 thing protecting us from the Republicans’ dangerous agenda.** We know what they want to do if they regain control over the House, or the Senate, or both. They’ve been pretty clear about it:
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/21113?refcode=em20221028-1772&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=1772%2E420207%2Edizu2H)
[**If you do NOT consent to a future governed by these Republicans, we’re asking you to commit with us in these final few days. With you, we can reach $75,000 and go all in to hold the House — will you support us with a contribution?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/21113?refcode=em20221028-1772&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=1772%2E420207%2Edizu2H)
We shouldn’t have to spell it out, but since the Republicans clearly don’t agree...
The right to get an abortion matters.
The right to use contraception matters.
The right to love and marry who you choose matters.
The right to live in a safe, healthy environment matters.
**But they want to take it all away — and in 11 days, they’re going to try.** It would be a disaster for our democracy and all of our hard-won victories.
[**We’re doing everything in our power to support Democrats & hold the House – but we need to raise this $75,000 to keep going. Can we count on you, Peter?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/21113?refcode=em20221028-1772&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=1772%2E420207%2Edizu2H)
We can do this, together.
Jayapal HQ

subject: I’d be so grateful if you could contribute to our campaign today.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
It’s not cheap to organize everywhere and make sure voters — from the mountains to the coast, rural and urban alike — all hear that we understand their hopes and needs.
#

Hi there, I am reaching out myself before our October fundraising deadline to ask a favor of you.
My race for U.S. Senate is one of the most competitive races in the entire country. A new poll this week shows our race tied, and CNN says North Carolina is one of the three seats “most likely to flip” to Democrats.
Our campaign is throwing out the old playbook and running the kind of grassroots campaign it takes to win in North Carolina. It’s clear that our strategy is working.
But this is a significant undertaking. It’s not cheap to organize everywhere and make sure voters — from the mountains to the coast, rural and urban alike — all hear that we understand their hopes and needs.
I’m grateful for this team. The outpouring of support means the world to me. I sincerely mean it, and I hope you know that I do not make these asks lightly.
We cannot slow down or falter now, so please:
[**I am personally asking you to contribute $3 before our October deadline. With the race in a dead heat, your donation today could swing this race in our favor on Election Day.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221028-3-T1&t=1&akid=2146%2E357359%2Ez0EGxD)
