body:
[ https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=1001&akid=1148%2E61531%2Eyj0ku3 ]Welch for Vermont

Only 11 days left until the big day. We’ve been working nonstop to ensure Peter
is elected as Vermont’s next Senator on November 8 and we’re back with
some updates — check out what we’ve been up to on the campaign trail:

The Delegation for All Tour ️️[1]Sun emoji

Peter joined Bernie Sanders and Becca Balint for the Delegation for All
Tour. It was a chance to show voters that if Peter and Becca are elected
alongside Bernie, Vermont would have the most progressive delegation in
the country.

The three rallied alongside Vermonters in St. Albans, Barre, and Hartland
over the weekend as we continued our get out the vote efforts, and the
enthusiasm is as high as ever. Take a look below:

[ https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4757?t=1002&akid=1148%2E61531%2Eyj0ku3 ]Peter with supporters and Bernie [ https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4757?t=1003&akid=1148%2E61531%2Eyj0ku3 ]Peter onstage
[ https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4757?t=1004&akid=1148%2E61531%2Eyj0ku3 ]Photo of supporters [ https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4757?t=1005&akid=1148%2E61531%2Eyj0ku3 ]Peter with more supporters

As Bernie said, if there’s ever been a moment in American history when
we’ve needed a progressive movement like ours, it’s right now. A special
thanks to everyone who attended!

The Welch Wagon Continues to Roll Along [6]Car emoji

The “Welch Wagon” 14 County Tour keeps making its way across the state,
stopping in Essex and Windsor counties. In Essex, we hosted a “Post-Up
with Peter” Meet & Greet at April’s Maple in Canaan:

[ https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4757?t=1006&akid=1148%2E61531%2Eyj0ku3 ]Peter at April's Maple [ https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4757?t=1007&akid=1148%2E61531%2Eyj0ku3 ]Peter talking with a supporter
[ https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4757?t=1008&akid=1148%2E61531%2Eyj0ku3 ]Peter talking to a crowd [ https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4757?t=1009&akid=1148%2E61531%2Eyj0ku3 ]Peter and supporters giving a thumbs up

And in Windsor, we started with a Meet & Greet at Piecemeal Pies, followed
by visits to Hotel Coolidge, Sunrise Farm, and First Branch Coffee, before
bringing the afternoon to a close chatting with students at the Vermont
Law School:

[ https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4757?t=1010&akid=1148%2E61531%2Eyj0ku3 ]Peter with supporters [ https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4757?t=1011&akid=1148%2E61531%2Eyj0ku3 ]Peter with supporters
[ https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4757?t=1012&akid=1148%2E61531%2Eyj0ku3 ]Peter with supporters [ https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4757?t=1013&akid=1148%2E61531%2Eyj0ku3 ]Peter speaking to students

With these stops in Essex and Windsor, we’re officially eight stops into
the “Welch Wagon” tour with just another six to go before Election Day —
stay tuned for more details on where Peter’s heading next!

Debate Night [15]Mic emoji

On Wednesday, Peter participated in the third debate of the general
election.

[ https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4757?t=1014&akid=1148%2E61531%2Eyj0ku3 ]Peter on stage at the debate

Much like in the previous two, Peter laid out our progressive vision for
Vermont and the country, while our opponent proved once more just how
dangerous it would be to give the GOP this seat and control of the Senate.

Peter’s performance on that debate stage left no doubt that he’s the right
candidate for this moment, but that alone doesn’t guarantee us victory.
Now, it’s about maximizing the 11 days remaining and ensuring we’ve done
everything we can to elect Peter our next U.S. Senator.

Our Final End-of-Month Deadline Is Monday! [17]Ghost emoji

With
just over a week until the midterms, there’s not a second to spare if
we’re going to win this election for Peter.

The Senate’s currently on a knife’s edge, split down the middle 50/50, and
experts like those at FiveThirtyEight are still saying control of the
chamber is a toss-up. That means Peter winning this seat in Vermont could
very well be the difference between us advancing our progressive vision,
or Mitch McConnell and the GOP putting an end to everything we’re fighting
for.

With so much at stake, we’re leaving absolutely nothing to chance. That’s
why, only if you’re able, [ https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4757?t=1015&akid=1148%2E61531%2Eyj0ku3 ]we hope you’ll consider chipping in to our
final end-of-month goal of the election. (A donation of any amount earns
you a spot on our Donor Wall in the office!!!) We’re edging closer and
closer to the finish line, and we’d really appreciate your support getting
us there.

[ https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4757?t=1018&t=1019&akid=1148%2E61531%2Eyj0ku3 ]DONATE

We guarantee you’ll continue to be among the first to know everything
taking place in the final days of this race. And if you live in the six
counties we haven’t visited yet? Stay on the watch for the Welch Wagon —
it’ll be near you before you know it.

Thanks so much!

Team Welch

P.S. There are still plenty of ways for you to get involved and help us
elect Peter to the U.S. Senate ahead of Election Day. [ https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/volunteer?source=em_20221028_f_t_update&t=1016&akid=1148%2E61531%2Eyj0ku3 ]Visit our
website and sign up to volunteer today.

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.welchforvermont.com/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=1148%2E61531%2Eyj0ku3

body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresshttps://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20221028_2 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20221028_2]
Team,
Yesterday was a big day on Team Slotkin – Congresswoman Liz Cheney endorsed Elissa in her re-election campaign, the first time that she has formally endorsed a Democrat.
This morning, Morning Joe discussed the endorsement with Jon Meacham, author of The Soul of America, a book Elissa has been quoting from lately. Check it out:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20221028_2 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20221028_2]
The theme of the segment was “principle over party” and that our country has always come out of its toughest times with two things: engaged citizens and principled leaders. It’s a sentiment that has come to be associated with Congresswoman Cheney, and one Elissa frequently discusses on the trail.
Near the end of the segment, Jon Meacham specifically said: “I think what Liz Cheney’s done is remarkable, I wish more people would do it. And I think that not just history, but people of good will around the country should honor her for it, and listen to her – and vote for Representative Slotkin.”
We couldn’t agree more. We hope you check out the full clip, and chip in below if you want to help us 11 days strong. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20221028_2]

name: Ken Burns
subject: Never have I felt such a threat to our democracy
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mandela Barnes for Wisconsin
body:
#
Friends —
I've spent more than four decades making films that tell America’s stories, and examining the crises – internal and external – that we have faced as a nation, including threats to our democracy.
>From the Civil War to the Great Depression, from the First and Second World Wars to the COVID-19 pandemic, these crises have challenged us to live up to the essential promise of our nation, preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Today, challenges to our republic are rampant, the democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
That’s why I’m reaching out. **With a 50-50 split in the Senate, the fate of our Democratic majority—and our very democracy—hinges on what happens in New Hampshire and Wisconsin.**
Maggie Hassan is a vital voice in the Senate, and we cannot afford to lose her tireless work on behalf of Granite Staters—and in fact all Americans. This November, she's up against a far-right election denier who believes a woman’s most personal decisions about abortion—decisions about her own body—belong in the hands of Republican “gentlemen” lawmakers.
Our country stands at a crossroads, and it's up to us to decide which direction we’ll take. Either we plunge down the path of extremism that Maggie's opponent has taken, or we choose the other way—the higher road—and come together to support leaders like Maggie who will fight to protect our future.
Maggie won her last race by just 1,017 votes. That was one of the closest margins in American history. And Republicans are targeting her race with $55 million in attack ads. With just 12 days left until the election, we need to have the resources necessary to turn out every last vote.
[**So I'm asking you now: will you help meet this moment by splitting a donation between Maggie Hassan and Mandela Barnes today?**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-hassan-split.riVec8&refcode=em221028-4-gm-full-p4&t=1&akid=3867%2E196590%2EaoF8PM)
Thank you,
Ken

We'd hate to see you go, but if you'd like you can [**unsubscribe here**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=2&akid=3867%2E196590%2EaoF8PM). You can also [**sign up to receive fewer emails.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/signup/fewer-emails/?source=em-footer&t=3&akid=3867%2E196590%2EaoF8PM)
Mandela is counting on people like you to fund this campaign. [**Make a contribution to stand with Mandela today.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mandela-em-footer?refcode=em-footer&t=4&refcode2=3867_196590_aoF8PM&akid=3867%2E196590%2EaoF8PM)
Submit this form to [**update your contact information.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/signup/update-contact-info/?source=em-footer&t=5&akid=3867%2E196590%2EaoF8PM)

name: Tim Ryan
subject: our largest goal ever
disclaimer_text: Paid for by UNITEDemocrats PAC
body:
| Peter,

Our FINAL end-of-month deadline is in 3 days. This is a HUGE deal because it’s our last chance to fully fund our TV ads and Get-Out-the-Vote efforts before the Election.

We have to send a strong message that our team is ready to fight back against the GOP’s attacks and flip Ohio blue. **So we’ve set an ambitious goal to raise $5 million online.**

| | Friend, I'm a cattle rancher, a husband and father, a businessman, and a seventh-generation Tennessean. At my company, I worked with electricians, pipe fitters, and plumbers for decades. _I spent much of my life working to improve the lives of the 1,200 hardworking folks at Lee Company._ **Now, I’m focused on improving Tennessee for the 6.9 million families building their own American Dream in our state. And I believe that dream starts with safety.** Some ‘leaders’ across the country think defunding the police will somehow solve crime and make folks safer. _**I am NOT one of those people.**_ **That’s why my administration launched a $100M Violent Crime Intervention Fund to fight crime in Tennessee...**** _by extending more resources to our brave law enforcement officers._** [**_I joined Fox News to talk about crime in America and the action we’re taking here in Tennessee. Watch the clip here >>_**](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=9a85b19046&e=fdefed58de)

Friend, I’m running for Congress in one of the most competitive races in the entire country. **[In a moment, I’m going to ask you to contribute to our last end-of-month fundraising goal. But if you don’t have time to read this email right now, can you please chip in before you click away?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53543993/375795664/1110132872?refcode=em_fr_2022.10.28_b3_Ap_all-nd&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YzNjN2RiYS0xODU3LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cWfwDocpNwaakiLsNWdIVRykHhH57iyg3dVz1H7P--M=)** My dad immigrated to the U.S. from Mexico in 1950. He believed in the power of hard work to make a difference. He worked in the fields, served two tours in Vietnam, and took a union job to provide a path into the middle class for our family. While we didn’t have a lot growing up, my family believed that through hard work, you can achieve anything. It took me seven years to graduate college – and I juggled multiple jobs, from painting houses to pouring coffee – but I put in the hard work and earned that degree. My daughter was born 17 years ago, and my family’s hard work gave me the determination that I needed to leave the world a better place for her. That’s why I stepped up to join the Oregon legislature. As a legislator, I’ve fought for more affordable health care, helped Oregon begin to tackle our climate crisis, and passed the nation’s most progressive paid family leave bill. It takes hard work to get these things done, but I was determined. With that same level of determination, I’m running for Congress. I’m ready to fight for families just like mine in Congress, **[but I need your help.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53543994/375795665/1110132872?refcode=em_fr_2022.10.28_b3_Ap_all-nd&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YzNjN2RiYS0xODU3LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cWfwDocpNwaakiLsNWdIVRykHhH57iyg3dVz1H7P--M=)** My team and I are racing to close our $20,000 budget gap before the end of the month so we can stay competitive in the final moments of this race. clean_body: This is important. = Friend, I’m running for Congress in one of the most competitive races in the entire country. = My dad immigrated to the U.S. from Mexico in 1950. He believed in the power of hard work to make a difference. He worked in the fields, served two tours in Vietnam, and took a union job to provide a path into the middle class for our family. While we didn’t have a lot growing up, my family believed that through hard work, you can achieve anything. It took me seven years to graduate college – and I juggled multiple jobs, from painting houses to pouring coffee – but I put in the hard work and earned that degree. My daughter was born 17 years ago, and my family’s hard work gave me the determination that I needed to leave the world a better place for her. That’s why I stepped up to join the Oregon legislature. As a legislator, I’ve fought for more affordable health care, helped Oregon begin to tackle our climate crisis, and passed the nation’s most progressive paid family leave bill. It takes hard work to get these things done, but I was determined. With that same level of determination, I’m running for Congress. I’m ready to fight for families just like mine in Congress, = My team and I are racing to close our $20,000 budget gap before the end of the month so we can stay competitive in the final moments of this race. | Team,

I am used to being underestimated. I came to this country from Colombia as a teenager and worked my way through college by waiting tables. I started my own business at 22 and it continues to thrive today. When other Democrats were falling short to MAGA Republicans in the Florida State Senate, I won and became the first Latina Democrat elected in the chamber’s history

A lot of people have written my race off as “unwinnable” because of partisan redistricting. So there’s no chance for me, right?

Wrong. I have been a fighter all my life.

We are less than two weeks away from Election Day, and **the momentum on the ground is palpable.** South Floridians are energized by our message, and support for this people-powered campaign just continues to grow.

I couldn’t be more confident that we are on track to flip this seat, but only if we keep up our momentum. And there is too much at stake in Florida, not to mention the country, for us to lose. Peter, we’re approaching our final end-of-month deadline before
Election Day. It’s just three days away!

After the clock strikes midnight on Monday, we’ll know if we’ve hit our
end-of-October fundraising goals -- and so will Rand Paul.

If we don’t reach our goal before midnight on Monday, we’ll fall behind at
the worst possible moment in the campaign.

$25.01 (our average donation size) or more to help us reach our final

Charles Booker
